)\n            new_val = cur * b\n        else:\n            b = rng.choice([2, 3, 4, 5])\n            text_parts.append(\n                f\"Then the {unit} are split evenly into {b} groups and {name} keeps one group.\"\n            )\n            new_val = cur // b\n        trace.append({\"a\": cur, \"op\": op, \"b\": b, \"result\": new_val})\n        cur = new_val\n    text_parts.append(f\"How many {unit} does {name} have now?\")\n    return Problem(pid=pid, text=\" \".join(text_parts), trace=trace, gold_answer=cur)\n\n\ndef build_problem_set(n: int, seed: int = 42) -> list[Problem]:\n    rng = random.Random(seed)\n    return [gen_synthetic_problem(f\"synth_{i:04d}\", rng) for i in range(n)]\n\n\ndef digit_root(x) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Closed-form casting-out-nines digit root: 1+(n-1)%9 for n>0, 0 for n=0.\"\"\"\n    x = abs(int(round(x)))\n    if x == 0:\n        return 0\n    return 1 + (x - 1) % 9\n\n\ndef digit_root_brute_force(x) -> int:\n    x = abs(int(round(x)))\n    while x >= 10:\n        x = sum(int(c) for c in str(x))\n    return x\n\n\ndef self_check_digit_root() -> None:\n    \"\"\"Cross-check the closed-form digit_root against brute-force repeated\n    digit-summing before trusting it at scale (STEP 4 requirement).\"\"\"\n    for x in [0, 1, 9, 10, 17, 45, 99, 100, 295, 401, 999, 12345, 987654]:\n        a, b = digit_root(x), digit_root_brute_force(x)\n        assert a == b, f\"digit_root mismatch at x={x}: closed-form={a} brute-force={b}\"\n    logger.info(\"digit_root self-check PASSED (closed-form == brute-force on 13 test values)\")\n\n\ndef checksum_consistent(a: int, op: str, b: int, result: int) -> bool:\n    da, db, dr = digit_root(a), digit_root(b), digit_root(result)\n    if op == \"+\":\n        return (da + db) % 9 == dr % 9 or (da + db == 0 and dr == 0)\n    if op == \"-\":\n        return (da - db) % 9 == dr % 9\n    if op == \"*\":\n        return (da * db) % 9 == dr % 9 or (da * db == 0 and dr == 0)\n    if op == \"//\":\n        if b == 0:\n            return False\n        remainder = a - b * result\n        return checksum_consistent(b, \"*\", result, a - remainder)\n    raise ValueError(f\"unknown op {op}\")\n\n\ndef inject_error(problem: Problem, rng: random.Random) -> dict | None:\n    if not problem.trace:\n        return None\n    idx = rng.randrange(len(problem.trace))\n    step = problem.trace[idx]\n    perturb_kind = rng.choice([\"off_by_one_digit\", \"transpose_digits\", \"off_by_carry\"])\n    wrong_result = step[\"result\"]\n    if perturb_kind == \"off_by_one_digit\":\n        delta = rng.choice([-1, 1]) * rng.choice([1, 10])\n        wrong_result = step[\"result\"] + delta\n    elif perturb_kind == \"transpose_digits\":\n        s = str(abs(step[\"result\"]))\n        if len(s) >= 2:\n            i = rng.randrange(len(s) - 1)\n            s2 = s[:i] + s[i + 1] + s[i] + s[i + 2 :]\n            wrong_result = int(s2) if step[\"result\"] >= 0 else -int(s2)\n        else:\n            wrong_result = step[\"result\"] + 10\n    else:\n        wrong_result = step[\"result\"] + rng.choice([-9, 9, -18, 18])\n    if wrong_result == step[\"result\"]:\n        wrong_result += 1\n    return {\n        \"problem_id\": problem.pid,\n        \"step_index\": idx,\n        \"a\": step[\"a\"],\n        \"op\": step[\"op\"],\n        \"b\": step[\"b\"],\n        \"correct_result\": step[\"result\"],\n        \"wrong_result\": wrong_result,\n    }\n\n\ndef characterize_errors(problems: list[Problem], seed: int = 7) -> dict:\n    rng = random.Random(seed)\n    detectable_by_pid: dict[str, bool] = {}\n    for problem in problems:\n        err = inject_error(problem, rng)\n        if err is None:\n            continue\n        flagged = not checksum_consistent(err[\"a\"], err[\"op\"], err[\"b\"], err[\"wrong_result\"])\n        detectable_by_pid[problem.pid] = flagged\n    return detectable_by_pid\n\n\ndef verify_reproduction(problems: list[Problem], experiment_meta: dict) -> dict:\n    detectable_by_pid = characterize_errors(problems)\n    n_detectable = sum(detectable_by_pid.values())\n    n_total = len(detectable_by_pid)\n    fraction = n_detectable / n_total if n_total else 0.0\n    reported = experiment_meta.get(\"checksum_detectable_fraction\")\n    reported_n = experiment_meta.get(\"n_checksum_detectable\")\n    reported_total = experiment_meta.get(\"n_injected_errors_characterized\")\n    logger.info(\n        f\"Reproduced characterization: {n_detectable}/{n_total} detectable \"\n        f\"(fraction={fraction:.4f}) vs experiment-reported {reported_n}/{reported_total} \"\n        f\"(fraction={reported})\"\n    )\n    ok = True\n    if reported_total is not None and n_total != reported_total:\n        ok = False\n    if reported is not None and abs(fraction - reported) > 1e-9:\n        ok = False\n    if not ok:\n        raise RuntimeError(\n            \"Reproduction mismatch against experiment metadata -- seeds/logic diverged, \"\n            \"cannot trust recovered checksum_detectable labels\"\n        )\n    logger.info(\"Reproduction VERIFIED exactly against experiment metadata.\")\n    return detectable_by_pid\n\n\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #\n# Load experiment predictions\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #\n\n\ndef load_experiment_records() -> tuple[list[dict], dict, dict]:\n    method_out_path = PRIOR_EXPERIMENT_DIR / \"method_out.json\"\n    if not method_out_path.exists():\n        raise FileNotFoundError(f\"No experiment output found at {method_out_path}\")\n    logger.info(f\"Loading experiment output: {method_out_path}\")\n    out = json.loads(method_out_path.read_text())\n    meta = out[\"metadata\"]\n    records, join_report = _records_from_method_out(out)\n    logger.info(f\"Loaded {len(records)} usable per-task records from method_out.json\")\n    return records, meta, join_report\n\n\ndef _records_from_method_out(out: dict) -> tuple[list[dict], dict]:\n    \"\"\"method_out.json stores predictions inlined per example as\n    predict_<condition>_<tier> JSON strings; flatten into per-task records.\n    Also performs the STEP-1 join-coverage accounting (matched vs unmatched\n    with reasons) against the experiment's own claimed n_total_llm_calls.\"\"\"\n    records = []\n    n_unparseable_predict_blob = 0\n    unmatched_reasons: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)\n    for i, ex in enumerate(out[\"datasets\"][0][\"examples\"]):\n        pid = f\"synth_{i:04d}\"\n        gold = ex[\"metadata_gold_answer\"]\n        for key, val in ex.items():\n            if not key.startswith(\"predict_\"):\n                continue\n            try:\n                payload = json.loads(val)\n            except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):\n                n_unparseable_predict_blob += 1\n                unmatched_reasons[\"predict_blob_json_parse_failure\"] += 1\n                continue\n            rest = key[len(\"predict_\") :]\n            if rest.startswith(\"oracle_\"):\n                condition = \"oracle_detection_isolation\"\n                tier = rest[len(\"oracle_\") :]\n            else:\n                tier = rest.rsplit(\"_\", 1)[-1]\n                condition = rest[: -(len(tier) + 1)]\n            model_id = next((m[\"id\"] for m in out[\"metadata\"][\"models\"] if m[\"tier\"] == tier), tier)\n            if payload.get(\"raw_response\", \"\") == \"\" and \"error\" in payload:\n                unmatched_reasons[f\"api_error:{payload.get('error', 'unknown')[:60]}\"] += 1\n                continue\n            fa = payload.get(\"final_answer\")\n            records.append(\n                {\n                    \"model\": model_id,\n                    \"tier\": tier,\n                    \"problem_id\": pid,\n                    \"condition\": condition,\n                    \"gold_answer\": gold,\n                    \"final_answer\": fa,\n                    \"initial_answer\": fa,\n                    \"flagged_error\": payload.get(\"flagged_error\", False),\n                    \"is_correct\": payload.get(\"is_correct\", False),\n                    \"raw_response\": payload.get(\"raw_response\", \"\"),\n                    \"response_chars\": len(payload.get(\"raw_response\", \"\") or \"\"),\n                    \"checksum_claims\": [],\n                }\n            )\n    n_expected = out[\"metadata\"][\"sample_sizes\"][\"n_total_llm_calls\"]\n    n_matched = len(records)\n    n_unmatched = n_expected - n_matched\n    join_report = {\n        \"n_expected_total_llm_calls\": n_expected,\n        \"n_matched_records\": n_matched,\n        \"n_unmatched\": max(n_unmatched, 0),\n        \"unmatched_reasons\": dict(unmatched_reasons),\n        \"n_reported_failed_calls_by_experiment\": out[\"metadata\"][\"sample_sizes\"].get(\"n_failed_calls\"),\n        \"note\": (\n            \"Matched = records with a parseable predict_* blob and a non-empty raw_response. \"\n            \"Unmatched rows are NOT silently dropped -- every one is accounted for above by reason.\"\n        ),\n    }\n    logger.info(f\"STEP1 join coverage: {n_matched} matched / {n_expected} expected ({n_unmatched} unmatched)\")\n    return records, join_report\n\n\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #\n# Response parsing (independent re-parse, mirrors method.py's own regexes)\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #\n\nANSWER_RE = re.compile(r\"answer\\s*[:=][^\\d-]{0,15}(-?[\\d,]+(?:\\.\\d+)?)\", re.IGNORECASE)\nFLAG_WORDS = re.compile(\n    r\"\\b(error|mistake|incorrect|wrong|revis|correct(ed)?\\s+(answer|value)|mismatch)\\b\", re.IGNORECASE\n)\n\n\ndef extract_all_answers(text: str) -> list[float]:\n    return [float(m.group(1).replace(\",\", \"\")) for m in ANSWER_RE.finditer(text or \"\")]\n\n\ndef independent_reparse(records: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:\n    n_mismatch = 0\n    n_checked = 0\n    for r in records:\n        text = r.get(\"raw_response\", \"\")\n        if not text:\n            continue\n        answers = extract_all_answers(text)\n        final = answers[-1] if answers else None\n        is_correct = final is not None and abs(final - r[\"gold_answer\"]) < 1e-6\n        flagged = bool(FLAG_WORDS.search(text))\n        n_checked += 1\n        if r.get(\"final_answer\") is not None and final is not None and abs((r[\"final_answer\"] or 0) - final) > 1e-6:\n            n_mismatch += 1\n        r[\"final_answer\"] = final\n        r[\"is_correct\"] = is_correct\n        r[\"flagged_error\"] = flagged\n    if n_checked:\n        logger.info(\n            f\"Independent re-parse of {n_checked} raw responses: {n_mismatch} final-answer \"\n            f\"disagreements with the experiment's own parse ({n_mismatch / n_checked:.1%})\"\n        )\n    return records\n\n\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #\n# Statistics\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #\n\n\ndef wilson_ci(k: int, n: int, z: float = 1.959963984540054) -> tuple[float | None, float | None, float | None]:\n    if n == 0:\n        return (None, None, None)\n    p = k / n\n    denom = 1 + z**2 / n\n    center = (p + z**2 / (2 * n)) / denom\n    halfwidth = z * math.sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z**2 / (4 * n**2)) / denom\n    return (p, max(0.0, center - halfwidth), min(1.0, center + halfwidth))\n\n\ndef prf_with_ci(tp: int, fp: int, fn: int, tn: int) -> dict:\n    n_pred_pos = tp + fp\n    n_actual_pos = tp + fn\n    n_total = tp + fp + fn + tn\n    precision, prec_lo, prec_hi = wilson_ci(tp, n_pred_pos) if n_pred_pos else (None, None, None)\n    recall, rec_lo, rec_hi = wilson_ci(tp, n_actual_pos) if n_actual_pos else (None, None, None)\n    f1 = None\n    if precision is not None and recall is not None and (precision + recall) > 0:\n        f1 = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)\n    return {\n        \"n\": n_total,\n        \"tp\": tp,\n        \"fp\": fp,\n        \"fn\": fn,\n        \"tn\": tn,\n        \"n_predicted_positive\": n_pred_pos,\n        \"n_actual_positive\": n_actual_pos,\n        \"precision\": precision,\n        \"precision_ci95\": [prec_lo, prec_hi] if precision is not None else None,\n        \"recall\": recall,\n        \"recall_ci95\": [rec_lo, rec_hi] if recall is not None else None,\n        \"f1\": f1,\n        \"underpowered_n_lt_20\": n_total < 20,\n    }\n\n\ndef cohens_kappa(pairs: list[tuple[bool, bool]]) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"pairs: list of (rater_a_flag, rater_b_flag) booleans, paired per item.\"\"\"\n    n = len(pairs)\n    if n == 0:\n        return {\"n\": 0, \"kappa\": None, \"po\": None, \"pe\": None}\n    both_true = sum(1 for a, b in pairs if a and b)\n    both_false = sum(1 for a, b in pairs if not a and not b)\n    a_true = sum(1 for a, _ in pairs if a)\n    b_true = sum(1 for _, b in pairs if b)\n    po = (both_true + both_false) / n\n    pe = (a_true / n) * (b_true / n) + (1 - a_true / n) * (1 - b_true / n)\n    kappa = (po - pe) / (1 - pe) if pe != 1.0 else None\n    return {\"n\": n, \"kappa\": kappa, \"po\": po, \"pe\": pe}\n\n\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #\n# STEP 4: deterministic mod-9 (digit-root) arithmetic checker -- NO LLM calls.\n# Regex derived by inspecting real checksum_critique traces: models state\n# \"Digit root of <N>: <arithmetic reduction chain ending in a single digit>\".\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #\n\n# Anchored on a colon directly after the operand (\"Digit root of 295: 2+9+5 = 16\n# -> 1+6 = 7\") -- this is how every genuine dedicated digit-root claim in the\n# inspected traces is phrased. The rest-of-line char class deliberately\n# excludes letters, so it naturally stops before prose and before composite\n# \"Digit root of A (rootA) - Digit root of B (rootB) = ...\" verification lines,\n# which never have a colon immediately after the first operand and would\n# otherwise contaminate the claimed value with the check's own arithmetic.\nDIGIT_ROOT_CLAIM_RE = re.compile(r\"[Dd]igit root of (-?\\d+)\\s*:\\s*([0-9+\\-*/=→.,()\\s]*)\")\nTRAILING_INT_RE = re.compile(r\"-?\\d+\")\n\n\ndef check_trace_deterministic(raw_response: str) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Parses every 'digit root of N: ...' claim in a trace, independently\n    recomputes the true digit root via the closed-form formula, and flags any\n    claim whose stated value disagrees with the recomputation.\"\"\"\n    claims = []\n    for m in DIGIT_ROOT_CLAIM_RE.finditer(raw_response or \"\"):\n        operand_str, rest = m.group(1), m.group(2)\n        operand = int(operand_str)\n        ints_in_rest = TRAILING_INT_RE.findall(rest)\n        if not ints_in_rest:\n            continue\n        claimed = int(ints_in_rest[-1])\n        if not (0 <= claimed <= 9):\n            continue  # not a single-digit claim -- likely mid-reduction fragment, skip\n        true_root = digit_root(operand)\n        claims.append({\"operand\": operand, \"claimed_root\": claimed, \"true_root\": true_root, \"match\": claimed == true_root})\n    n_claims = len(claims)\n    n_mismatches = sum(1 for c in claims if not c[\"match\"])\n    return {\n        \"n_claims_parsed\": n_claims,\n        \"n_mismatches\": n_mismatches,\n        \"has_arithmetic_error\": n_mismatches > 0,\n        \"claims\": claims,\n    }\n\n\nJUDGE_MODEL = \"anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5\"\nJUDGE_RUBRIC = (\n    \"You are auditing a math self-critique transcript. The transcript should contain, \"\n    \"for one or more arithmetic sub-steps, an explicit 'digit root' (repeated digit sum, \"\n    \"a.k.a. casting-out-nines mod-9 checksum) computation for two operands and a result, \"\n    \"followed by a CHECKSUM_OK or CHECKSUM_MISMATCH verdict.\\n\\n\"\n    \"Your job: independently RECOMPUTE the digit root of every operand and result named in \"\n    \"each checksum check shown (digit root = repeatedly sum the number's digits until one \"\n    \"digit remains, e.g. digit_root(295)=2+9+5=16->1+6=7), and RECOMPUTE the mod-9 relationship \"\n    \"(operand digit roots combined by the step's +/-/* operator, taken mod 9) the transcript \"\n    \"claims to verify. Work through each check step by step, showing your own recomputation, \"\n    \"before giving a verdict -- do not just trust the transcript's stated numbers.\\n\\n\"\n    \"After showing your work for every checksum check in the transcript, end your reply with a \"\n    \"final line containing EXACTLY one of: 'VERDICT: CORRECT' if every digit-root computation and \"\n    \"CHECKSUM_OK/CHECKSUM_MISMATCH verdict shown is arithmetically correct by your own recomputation, \"\n    \"'VERDICT: INCORRECT' if at least one digit-root computation or verdict shown is wrong, or \"\n    \"'VERDICT: NO_CHECKSUM_SHOWN' if the transcript contains no digit-root/checksum work to audit.\"\n)\n\n\ndef reproduce_prior_judge_sample(records: list[dict], per_model_sample: int = 50, seed: int = 3) -> list[dict]:\n    \"\"\"Bit-for-bit reproduction of art_VCF3BbfSo_RV's audit_checksum_computation()\n    sampling (same seed, same grouping order over the same records list) so\n    STEP4's kappa is computed on the SAME sample the prior LLM-judge audited.\"\"\"\n    rng = random.Random(seed)\n    by_model: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}\n    for r in records:\n        if r[\"condition\"] == \"checksum_critique\" and r.get(\"raw_response\"):\n            by_model.setdefault(r[\"model\"], []).append(r)\n    tasks = []\n    for _model, recs in by_model.items():\n        sample = recs if len(recs) <= per_model_sample else rng.sample(recs, per_model_sample)\n        tasks.extend(sample)\n    return tasks\n\n\ndef run_llm_judge(tasks: list[dict], budget_usd: float) -> list[dict]:\n    if not tasks:\n        return []\n    orcall.init_openrouter_call()\n    price = {\"input\": 1.0e-6, \"output\": 5.0e-6}\n    results = []\n    total_cost = 0.0\n\n    def judge_one(rec: dict) -> dict:\n        prompt = JUDGE_RUBRIC + \"\\n\\nTRANSCRIPT:\\n\" + rec[\"raw_response\"][:6000]\n        for attempt in range(3):\n            try:\n                out = orcall.core_openrouter_call(model=JUDGE_MODEL, input_text=prompt, max_tokens=800, temperature=0.0)\n                if out.get(\"success\"):\n                    verdict_text = (out.get(\"response\") or out.get(\"text\") or \"\").strip().upper()\n                    verdict_lines = [ln for ln in verdict_text.splitlines() if \"VERDICT\" in ln]\n                    tail = verdict_lines[-1] if verdict_lines else verdict_text\n                    if \"NO_CHECKSUM\" in tail:\n                        verdict = \"NO_CHECKSUM_SHOWN\"\n                    elif \"INCORRECT\" in tail:\n                        verdict = \"INCORRECT\"\n                    elif \"CORRECT\" in tail:\n                        verdict = \"CORRECT\"\n                    else:\n                        verdict = \"UNPARSEABLE\"\n                    cost = (out.get(\"input_tokens\", 0) or 0) * price[\"input\"] + (out.get(\"output_tokens\", 0) or 0) * price[\"output\"]\n                    return {\"model\": rec[\"model\"], \"problem_id\": rec[\"problem_id\"], \"verdict\": verdict, \"cost_usd\": cost}\n                time.sleep(1.0 * (attempt + 1))\n            except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001\n                logger.error(f\"Judge call failed (attempt {attempt+1}/3): {e}\")\n                time.sleep(1.0 * (attempt + 1))\n        return {\"model\": rec[\"model\"], \"problem_id\": rec[\"problem_id\"], \"verdict\": \"CALL_FAILED\", \"cost_usd\": 0.0}\n\n    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as pool:\n        futures = {pool.submit(judge_one, r): r for r in tasks}\n        for fut in as_completed(futures):\n            res = fut.result()\n            results.append(res)\n            total_cost += res[\"cost_usd\"]\n            if total_cost >= budget_usd:\n                logger.warning(f\"LLM-judge sub-budget (${budget_usd}) reached; stopping remaining judge calls\")\n                for f in futures:\n                    f.cancel()\n                break\n    logger.info(f\"Fresh LLM-judge re-run: {len(results)} calls, ${total_cost:.4f}\")\n    return results\n\n\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #\n# STEP 2/3/5: precision/recall/F1 + correction-accuracy tables\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #\n\nCONDITIONS = [\"baseline\", \"freeform_critique\", \"placebo_critique\", \"checksum_critique\"]\n\n\ndef build_detection_table(\n    records: list[dict],\n    baseline_correct_by_key: dict[tuple[str, str], bool],\n    detectable_by_pid: dict[str, bool],\n    exclude_keys: set[tuple[str, str]] | None = None,\n) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"condition x model x detectability-split precision/recall/F1 table.\n    Ground truth = NOT baseline_correct[model,pid] (an error was actually\n    present, since baseline is a single unaided solve with no chance to\n    self-correct). Predicted = this condition's own flagged_error.\"\"\"\n    exclude_keys = exclude_keys or set()\n    table: dict = {}\n    for condition in CONDITIONS:\n        table[condition] = {}\n        for model in sorted({r[\"model\"] for r in records}):\n            cells: dict = {}\n            for split_name, split_val in [(\"overall\", None), (\"checksum_detectable\", True), (\"checksum_invisible\", False)]:\n                tp = fp = fn = tn = 0\n                for r in records:\n                    if r[\"condition\"] != condition or r[\"model\"] != model:\n                        continue\n                    key = (model, r[\"problem_id\"])\n                    if key in exclude_keys:\n                        continue\n                    if key not in baseline_correct_by_key:\n                        continue\n                    det = detectable_by_pid.get(r[\"problem_id\"])\n                    if split_val is not None and det != split_val:\n                        continue\n                    gt_error = not baseline_correct_by_key[key]\n                    pred_flag = bool(r[\"flagged_error\"])\n                    if gt_error and pred_flag:\n                        tp += 1\n                    elif not gt_error and pred_flag:\n                        fp += 1\n                    elif gt_error and not pred_flag:\n                        fn += 1\n                    else:\n                        tn += 1\n                cells[split_name] = prf_with_ci(tp, fp, fn, tn)\n            table[condition][model] = cells\n    return table\n\n\ndef build_correction_accuracy_table(records: list[dict], baseline_correct_by_key: dict[tuple[str, str], bool]) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"STEP3: among TP detections (flagged=True & baseline was actually wrong),\n    fraction where the condition's own final_answer == gold_answer.\"\"\"\n    table: dict = {}\n    for condition in CONDITIONS:\n        table[condition] = {}\n        for model in sorted({r[\"model\"] for r in records}):\n            tp_records = [\n                r\n                for r in records\n                if r[\"condition\"] == condition\n                and r[\"model\"] == model\n                and r[\"flagged_error\"]\n                and (model, r[\"problem_id\"]) in baseline_correct_by_key\n                and not baseline_correct_by_key[(model, r[\"problem_id\"])]\n            ]\n            n = len(tp_records)\n            k = sum(1 for r in tp_records if r[\"final_answer\"] is not None and abs(r[\"final_answer\"] - r[\"gold_answer\"]) < 1e-6)\n            p, lo, hi = wilson_ci(k, n) if n else (None, None, None)\n            table[condition][model] = {\n                \"n_tp\": n,\n                \"n_corrected_to_gold\": k,\n                \"correction_accuracy_given_tp\": p,\n                \"correction_accuracy_ci95\": [lo, hi] if p is not None else None,\n                \"underpowered_n_lt_20\": n < 20,\n            }\n    return table\n\n\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #\n# Main\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #\n\n\n@logger.catch(reraise=True)\ndef main() -> None:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--skip-judge\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"skip the fresh LLM-judge re-run (Step 4 kappa)\")\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n\n    self_check_digit_root()\n\n    if not NEW_EXPERIMENT_DIR.exists() or not any(NEW_EXPERIMENT_DIR.glob(\"*.json\")):\n        logger.warning(\n A shipment of {b} {unit} arrives.\\",\\n    \\"{name} has {a} {unit} and buys {b} more {unit} at the store.\\",\\n]\\nNAMES = [\\"Maria\\", \\"Jamal\\", \\"Wei\\", \\"Fatima\\", \\"Diego\\", \\"Priya\\", \\"Noah\\", \\"Aiko\\"]\\nUNITS = [\\"apples\\", \\"boxes\\", \\"coins\\", \\"stickers\\", \\"marbles\\", \\"tickets\\", \\"widgets\\"]\\n\\n\\nclass Problem:\\n    def __init__(self, pid: str, text: str, trace: list, gold_answer: int):\\n        self.pid = pid\\n        self.text = text\\n        self.trace = trace\\n        self.gold_answer = gold_answer\\n\\n\\ndef gen_synthetic_problem(pid: str, rng: random.Random) -> Problem:\\n    n_steps = rng.randint(3, 4)\\n    name = rng.choice(NAMES)\\n    unit = rng.choice(UNITS)\\n    a0 = rng.randint(20, 500)\\n    b0 = rng.randint(10, 300)\\n    template = rng.choice(TEMPLATES)\\n    text_parts = [template.format(name=name, unit=unit, a=a0, b=b0)]\\n    trace = []\\n    cur = a0 + b0\\n    trace.append({\\"a\\": a0, \\"op\\": \\"+\\", \\"b\\": b0, \\"result\\": cur})\\n    for _ in range(n_steps - 1):\\n        remaining_ops = [\\"+\\", \\"-\\", \\"*\\"]\\n        if cur >= 4:\\n            remaining_ops.append(\\"//\\")\\n        op = rng.choice(remaining_ops)\\n        if op == \\"+\\":\\n            b = rng.randint(5, 200)\\n            text_parts.append(f\\"Then {name} receives {b} more {unit}.\\")\\n            new_val = cur + b\\n        elif op == \\"-\\":\\n            b = rng.randint(5, max(6, min(cur - 1, 200)))\\n            b = min(b, cur - 1) if cur > 1 else 0\\n            text_parts.append(f\\"Then {name} gives away {b} {unit}.\\")\\n            new_val = cur - b\\n        elif op == \\"*\\":\\n            b = rng.randint(2, 4)\\n            text_parts.append(\\n                f\\"Then the number of {unit} is multiplied by {b} (e.g. distributed evenly {b} times over).\\"\\n            )\\n            new_val = cur * b\\n        else:\\n            b = rng.choice([2, 3, 4, 5])\\n            text_parts.append(\\n                f\\"Then the {unit} are split evenly into {b} groups and {name} keeps one group.\\"\\n            )\\n            new_val = cur // b\\n        trace.append({\\"a\\": cur, \\"op\\": op, \\"b\\": b, \\"result\\": new_val})\\n        cur = new_val\\n    text_parts.append(f\\"How many {unit} does {name} have now?\\")\\n    return Problem(pid=pid, text=\\" \\".join(text_parts), trace=trace, gold_answer=cur)\\n\\n\\ndef build_problem_set(n: int, seed: int = 42) -> list[Problem]:\\n    rng = random.Random(seed)\\n    return [gen_synthetic_problem(f\\"synth_{i:04d}\\", rng) for i in range(n)]\\n\\n\\ndef digit_root(x) -> int:\\n    \\"\\"\\"Closed-form casting-out-nines digit root: 1+(n-1)%9 for n>0, 0 for n=0.\\"\\"\\"\\n    x = abs(int(round(x)))\\n    if x == 0:\\n        return 0\\n    return 1 + (x - 1) % 9\\n\\n\\ndef digit_root_brute_force(x) -> int:\\n    x = abs(int(round(x)))\\n    while x >= 10:\\n        x = sum(int(c) for c in str(x))\\n    return x\\n\\n\\ndef self_check_digit_root() -> None:\\n    \\"\\"\\"Cross-check the closed-form digit_root against brute-force repeated\\n    digit-summing before trusting it at scale (STEP 4 requirement).\\"\\"\\"\\n    for x in [0, 1, 9, 10, 17, 45, 99, 100, 295, 401, 999, 12345, 987654]:\\n        a, b = digit_root(x), digit_root_brute_force(x)\\n        assert a == b, f\\"digit_root mismatch at x={x}: closed-form={a} brute-force={b}\\"\\n    logger.info(\\"digit_root self-check PASSED (closed-form == brute-force on 13 test values)\\")\\n\\n\\ndef checksum_consistent(a: int, op: str, b: int, result: int) -> bool:\\n    da, db, dr = digit_root(a), digit_root(b), digit_root(result)\\n    if op == \\"+\\":\\n        return (da + db) % 9 == dr % 9 or (da + db == 0 and dr == 0)\\n    if op == \\"-\\":\\n        return (da - db) % 9 == dr % 9\\n    if op == \\"*\\":\\n        return (da * db) % 9 == dr % 9 or (da * db == 0 and dr == 0)\\n    if op == \\"//\\":\\n        if b == 0:\\n            return False\\n        remainder = a - b * result\\n        return checksum_consistent(b, \\"*\\", result, a - remainder)\\n    raise ValueError(f\\"unknown op {op}\\")\\n\\n\\ndef inject_error(problem: Problem, rng: random.Random) -> dict | None:\\n    if not problem.trace:\\n        return None\\n    idx = rng.randrange(len(problem.trace))\\n    step = problem.trace[idx]\\n    perturb_kind = rng.choice([\\"off_by_one_digit\\", \\"transpose_digits\\", \\"off_by_carry\\"])\\n    wrong_result = step[\\"result\\"]\\n    if perturb_kind == \\"off_by_one_digit\\":\\n        delta = rng.choice([-1, 1]) * rng.choice([1, 10])\\n        wrong_result = step[\\"result\\"] + delta\\n    elif perturb_kind == \\"transpose_digits\\":\\n        s = str(abs(step[\\"result\\"]))\\n        if len(s) >= 2:\\n            i = rng.randrange(len(s) - 1)\\n            s2 = s[:i] + s[i + 1] + s[i] + s[i + 2 :]\\n            wrong_result = int(s2) if step[\\"result\\"] >= 0 else -int(s2)\\n        else:\\n            wrong_result = step[\\"result\\"] + 10\\n    else:\\n        wrong_result = step[\\"result\\"] + rng.choice([-9, 9, -18, 18])\\n    if wrong_result == step[\\"result\\"]:\\n        wrong_result += 1\\n    return {\\n        \\"problem_id\\": problem.pid,\\n        \\"step_index\\": idx,\\n        \\"a\\": step[\\"a\\"],\\n        \\"op\\": step[\\"op\\"],\\n        \\"b\\": step[\\"b\\"],\\n        \\"correct_result\\": step[\\"result\\"],\\n        \\"wrong_result\\": wrong_result,\\n    }\\n\\n\\ndef characterize_errors(problems: list[Problem], seed: int = 7) -> dict:\\n    rng = random.Random(seed)\\n    detectable_by_pid: dict[str, bool] = {}\\n    for problem in problems:\\n        err = inject_error(problem, rng)\\n        if err is None:\\n            continue\\n        flagged = not checksum_consistent(err[\\"a\\"], err[\\"op\\"], err[\\"b\\"], err[\\"wrong_result\\"])\\n        detectable_by_pid[problem.pid] = flagged\\n    return detectable_by_pid'}
```

db) % 9 == dr % 9\\\\n    if op == \\\\\\\"*\\\\\\\":\\\\n        return (da * db) % 9 == dr % 9 or (da * db == 0 and dr == 0)\\\\n    if op == \\\\\\\"//\\\\\\\":\\\\n        if b == 0:\\\\n            return False\\\\n        remainder = a - b * result\\\\n        return checksum_consistent(b, \\\\\\\"*\\\\\\\", result, a - remainder)\\\\n    raise ValueError(f\\\\\\\"unknown op {op}\\\\\\\")\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef inject_error(problem: Problem, rng: random.Random) -> dict | None:\\\\n    if not problem.trace:\\\\n        return None\\\\n    idx = rng.randrange(len(problem.trace))\\\\n    step = problem.trace[idx]\\\\n    perturb_kind = rng.choice([\\\\\\\"off_by_one_digit\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"transpose_digits\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"off_by_carry\\\\\\\"])\\\\n    wrong_result = step[\\\\\\\"result\\\\\\\"]\\\\n    if perturb_kind == \\\\\\\"off_by_one_digit\\\\\\\":\\\\n        delta = rng.choice([-1, 1]) * rng.choice([1, 10])\\\\n        wrong_result = step[\\\\\\\"result\\\\\\\"] + delta\\\\n    elif perturb_kind == \\\\\\\"transpose_digits\\\\\\\":\\\\n        s = str(abs(step[\\\\\\\"result\\\\\\\"]))\\\\n        if len(s) >= 2:\\\\n            i = rng.randrange(len(s) - 1)\\\\n            s2 = s[:i] + s[i + 1] + s[i] + s[i + 2 :]\\\\n            wrong_result = int(s2) if step[\\\\\\\"result\\\\\\\"] >= 0 else -int(s2)\\\\n        else:\\\\n            wrong_result = step[\\\\\\\"result\\\\\\\"] + 10\\\\n    else:\\\\n        wrong_result = step[\\\\\\\"result\\\\\\\"] + rng.choice([-9, 9, -18, 18])\\\\n    if wrong_result == step[\\\\\\\"result\\\\\\\"]:\\\\n        wrong_result += 1\\\\n    return {\\\\n        \\\\\\\"problem_id\\\\\\\": problem.pid,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"step_index\\\\\\\": idx,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"a\\\\\\\": step[\\\\\\\"a\\\\\\\"],\\\\n        \\\\\\\"op\\\\\\\": step[\\\\\\\"op\\\\\\\"],\\\\n        \\\\\\\"b\\\\\\\": step[\\\\\\\"b\\\\\\\"],\\\\n        \\\\\\\"correct_result\\\\\\\": step[\\\\\\\"result\\\\\\\"],\\\\n        \\\\\\\"wrong_result\\\\\\\": wrong_result,\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef characterize_errors(problems: list[Problem], seed: int = 7) -> dict:\\\\n    rng = random.Random(seed)\\\\n    detectable_by_pid: dict[str, bool] = {}\\\\n    for problem in problems:\\\\n        err = inject_error(problem, rng)\\\\n        if err is None:\\\\n            continue\\\\n        flagged = not checksum_consistent(err[\\\\\\\"a\\\\\\\"], err[\\\\\\\"op\\\\\\\"], err[\\\\\\\"b\\\\\\\"], err[\\\\\\\"wrong_result\\\\\\\"])\\\\n        detectable_by_pid[problem.pid] = flagged\\\\n    return detectable_by_pid\",\n   \"metadata\": {},\n   \"execution_count\": null,\n   \"outputs\": []\n  }\n ],\n \"metadata\": {\n  \"kernelspec\": {\n   \"display_name\": \"Python 3\",\n   \"language\": \"python\",\n   \"name\": \"python3\"\n  },\n  \"language_info\": {\n   \"name\": \"python\",\n   \"version\": \"3.12.12\"\n  }\n },\n \"nbformat\": 4,\n \"nbformat_minor\": 5\n}"}

elif op == \\\\\\\"-\\\\\\\":\\\\n            b = rng.randint(5, max(6, min(cur - 1, 200)))\\\\n            b = min(b, cur - 1) if cur > 1 else 0\\\\n            text_parts.append(f\\\\\\\"Then {name} text_parts.append(f\\\\\\\"How many {unit} does {name} have now?\\\\\\\")\\\\n    return Problem(pid=pid, text=\\\\\\\" \\\\\\\".join(text_parts), trace=trace, gold_answer=cur)\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef None)\\\\n    p = k / n\\\\n    denom = 1 + z**2 / n\\\\n    center = (p + z**2 / (2 * n)) / denom\\\\n    halfwidth = z * math.sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z**2 / (4 * n**2)) / denom\\\\n    return (p,   n_total = tp + fp + fn + tn\\\\n    precision, prec_lo, prec_hi = wilson_ci(tp, n_pred_pos) if n_pred_pos else (None, None, None)\\\\n    recall, rec_lo, rec_hi = wilson_ci(tp, n_actual_pos) if n_actual_pos else (None, None, None)\\\\n    f1 = None\\\\n    if precision is not None and recall is not None and (precision + recall) > 0:\\\\n        f1 = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)\\\\n    return {\\\\n        \\\\\\\"n\\\\\\\": n_total,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"tp\\\\\\\": tp,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"fp\\\\\\\": fp,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"fn\\\\\\\": fn,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"tn\\\\\\\": tn,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"n_predicted_positive\\\\\\\": n_pred_pos,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"n_actual_positive\\\\\\\": n_actual_pos,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"precision\\\\\\\": list[tuple[bool, bool]]) -> dict:\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"pairs: list of (rater_a_flag, rater_b_flag) booleans, paired per item.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    n = len(pairs)\\\\n    if n == 0:\\\\n        return {\\\\\\\"n\\\\\\\": 0, \\\\\\\"kappa\\\\\\\": None, \\\\\\\"po\\\\\\\": None, \\\\\\\"pe\\\\\\\": None}\\\\n    both_true = sum(1 for a, b in pairs if a and b)\\\\n    both_false \"2e978fb8\",\n   \"source\": \"def wilson_ci(k: int, n: int, z: float = 1.959963984540054) -> tuple[float | None, float | None, float | None]:\\\\n    if n == 0:\\\\n        return (None, None, None)\\\\n    p = k / n\\\\n    denom = 1 + z**2 / n\\\\n    center = (p + z**2 / (2 * n)) / denom\\\\n    halfwidth = z * math.sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z**2 / (4 * n**2)) / denom\\\\n    return (p, max(0.0, center - halfwidth), min(1.0, center + halfwidth))\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef prf_with_ci(tp: int, fp: int, fn: int, tn: int) -> dict:\\\\n    n_pred_pos = tp + fp\\\\n    n_actual_pos = tp + fn\\\\n    n_total = tp + fp + fn + tn\\\\n    precision, prec_lo, prec_hi = wilson_ci(tp, n_pred_pos) if n_pred_pos else (None, None, None)\\\\n    recall, rec_lo, rec_hi = wilson_ci(tp, n_actual_pos) if n_actual_pos else (None, None, None)\\\\n    f1 = None\\\\n    if precision is not None and recall is not None and (precision + recall) > 0:\\\\n        f1 = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)\\\\n    return {\\\\n        \\\\\\\"n\\\\\\\": n_total,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"tp\\\\\\\": tp,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"fp\\\\\\\": fp,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"fn\\\\\\\": fn,\\\\n \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"),\\\\n                }\\\\n            )\\\\n    n_expected = sum(1 for ex in examples for k in ex if k.startswith(\\\\\\\"predict_\\\\\\\"))\\\\n    n_matched = len(records)\\\\n    n_unmatched = n_expected - n_matched\\\\n    join_report = {\\\\n        \\\\\\\"n_expected_total_llm_calls\\\\\\\": n_expected,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"n_matched_records\\\\\\\": n_matched,\\\\n intervals\\\\n\\\\nGround truth for \\\\\\\"an error was present\\\\\\\" = the same model's **baseline** (no-critique) solve on that problem was wrong. Predicted = the condition's own `flagged_error`. Each condition x model x detectability-split cell gets a closed-form Wilson 95% CI and an explicit `n<20`-underpowered flag rather than a bare point estimate. STEP 3 additionally computes, among true-positive detections, what fraction were actually corrected to the gold answer.\",\n   \"metadata\": {}\n  },\n  {\n   \"cell_type\": \"code\",\n   \"id\": \"2e978fb8\",\n   \"source\": \"def wilson_ci(k: int, n: int, z: float = 1.959963984540054) -> tuple[float | None, float | None, float | None]:\\\\n    if n == 0:\\\\n        return (None, None, None)\\\\n    p = k / n\\\\n    denom = 1 + z**2 / n\\\\n    center = (p + z**2 / (2 * n)) / denom\\\\n    halfwidth = z * math.sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z**2 / (4 * n**2)) / denom\\\\n    return (p, max(0.0, center - halfwidth), min(1.0, center + halfwidth))\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef prf_with_ci(tp: int, fp: int, fn: int, tn: int) -> dict:\\\\n    n_pred_pos = tp + fp\\\\n    n_actual_pos = tp + fn\\\\n    n_total = tp + fp + fn + tn\\\\n    precision, prec_lo, prec_hi = wilson_ci(tp, n_pred_pos) if n_pred_pos else (None, None, None)\\\\n    recall, rec_lo, rec_hi = wilson_ci(tp, n_actual_pos) if n_actual_pos else (None, None, None)\\\\n    f1 = None\\\\n    if precision is not None and recall is not None and (precision + recall) > 0:\\\\n        f1 = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)\\\\n    return {\\\\n        \\\\\\\"n\\\\\\\": n_total,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"tp\\\\\\\": tp,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"fp\\\\\\\": fp,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"fn\\\\\\\": fn,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"tn\\\\\\\": tn,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"n_predicted_positive\\\\\\\": n_pred_pos,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"n_actual_positive\\\\\\\": n_actual_pos,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"precision\\\\\\\": precision,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"precision_ci95\\\\\\\": [prec_lo, prec_hi] if precision is not None else None,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"recall\\\\\\\": recall,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"recall_ci95\\\\\\\": [rec_lo, rec_hi] if recall is not None else None,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"f1\\\\\\\": f1,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"underpowered_n_lt_20\\\\\\\": n_total < 20,\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef cohens_kappa(pairs: list[tuple[bool, bool]]) -> dict:\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"pairs: list of (rater_a_flag, rater_b_flag) booleans, paired per item.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    n = len(pairs)\\\\n    if n == 0:\\\\n        return {\\\\\\\"n\\\\\\\": 0, \\\\\\\"kappa\\\\\\\": None, \\\\\\\"po\\\\\\\": None, \\\\\\\"pe\\\\\\\": None}\\\\n    both_true = sum(1 for a, b in pairs if a and b)\\\\n    both_false = sum(1 for a, b in pairs if not a and not b)\\\\n    a_true = sum(1 for a, _ in pairs if a)\\\\n    b_true = sum(1 for _, b in pairs if b)\\\\n    po = (both_true + both_false) / n\\\\n    pe = (a_true / n) * (b_true / n) + (1 - a_true / n) * (1 - b_true / n)\\\\n    kappa = (po - pe) / (1 - pe) if pe != 1.0 else None\\\\n    return {\\\\\\\"n\\\\\\\": n, \\\\\\\"kappa\\\\\\\": kappa, \\\\\\\"po\\\\\\\": po, \\\\\\\"pe\\\\\\\": pe}\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef build_detection_table(\\\\n    records: list[dict],\\\\n    baseline_correct_by_key: dict[tuple[str, str], bool],\\\\n    detectable_by_pid: dict[str, bool],\\\\n    exclude_keys: set[tuple[str, str]] | None = None,\\\\n) -> dict:\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"condition x model x detectability-split precision/recall/F1 table.\\\\n    Ground truth = NOT baseline_correct[model,pid] (an error was actually\\\\n    present, since baseline is a single unaided solve with no chance to\\\\n    self-correct). n_unmatched = n_expected - n_matched\\\\n    join_report = {\\\\n        \\\\\\\"n_expected_total_llm_calls\\\\\\\": n_expected,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"n_matched_records\\\\\\\": n_matched,\\\\n \"2e978fb8\",\n   \"source\": \"def wilson_ci(k: int, n: int, z: float = 1.959963984540054) -> tuple[float | None, float | None, float | None]:\\\\n    if n == 0:\\\\n        return (None, None, None)\\\\n    p = k / n\\\\n    denom = 1 + z**2 / n\\\\n    center = (p + z**2 / (2 * n)) / denom\\\\n    halfwidth = z * math.sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z**2 / (4 * n**2)) / denom\\\\n    return (p, max(0.0, center - halfwidth), min(1.0, center + halfwidth))\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef prf_with_ci(tp: int, fp: int, fn: int, tn: int) -> dict:\\\\n    n_pred_pos = tp + fp\\\\n    n_actual_pos = tp + fn\\\\n    n_total = tp + fp + fn + tn\\\\n    precision, prec_lo, prec_hi = wilson_ci(tp, n_pred_pos) if n_pred_pos else (None, None, None)\\\\n    recall, rec_lo, rec_hi = wilson_ci(tp, n_actual_pos) if n_actual_pos else (None, None, None)\\\\n    f1 = None\\\\n    if precision is not None and recall is not None and (precision + recall) > 0:\\\\n        f1 = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)\\\\n    return {\\\\n        \\\\\\\"n\\\\\\\": n_total,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"tp\\\\\\\": tp,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"fp\\\\\\\": fp,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"fn\\\\\\\": fn,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"tn\\\\\\\": tn,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"n_predicted_positive\\\\\\\": n_pred_pos,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"n_actual_positive\\\\\\\": n_actual_pos,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"precision\\\\\\\": precision,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"precision_ci95\\\\\\\": [prec_lo, prec_hi] if precision is not None else None,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"recall\\\\\\\": recall,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"recall_ci95\\\\\\\": [rec_lo, rec_hi] if recall is not None else None,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"f1\\\\\\\": f1,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"underpowered_n_lt_20\\\\\\\": n_total < 20,\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef cohens_kappa(pairs: list[tuple[bool, bool]]) -> dict:\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"pairs: list of (rater_a_flag, rater_b_flag) booleans, paired per item.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    n = len(pairs)\\\\n    if n == 0:\\\\n        return {\\\\\\\"n\\\\\\\": 0, \\\\\\\"kappa\\\\\\\": None, \\\\\\\"po\\\\\\\": None, \\\\\\\"pe\\\\\\\": None}\\\\n    both_true = sum(1 for a, b in pairs if a and b)\\\\n    both_false = sum(1 for a, b in pairs if not a and not b)\\\\n    a_true = sum(1 for a, _ in pairs if a)\\\\n    b_true = sum(1 for _, b in pairs if b)\\\\n    po = (both_true + both_false) / n\\\\n    pe = (a_true / n) * (b_true / n) + (1 - a_true / n) * (1 - b_true / n)\\\\n    kappa = (po - pe) / (1 - pe) if pe != 1.0 else None\\\\n    return {\\\\\\\"n\\\\\\\": n, \\\\\\\"kappa\\\\\\\": kappa, \\\\\\\"po\\\\\\\": po, \\\\\\\"pe\\\\\\\": pe}\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef build_detection_table(\\\\n    records: list[dict],\\\\n    baseline_correct_by_key: dict[tuple[str, str], bool],\\\\n    detectable_by_pid: dict[str, bool],\\\\n    exclude_keys: set[tuple[str, str]] | None = None,\\\\n) -> dict:\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"condition x model x detectability-split precision/recall/F1 table.\\\\n    Ground truth = NOT baseline_correct[model,pid] (an error was actually\\\\n    present, since baseline is a single unaided solve with no chance to\\\\n    self-correct). Predicted = this condition's own flagged_error.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    exclude_keys = exclude_keys or set()\\\\n    table: dict = {}\\\\n    for condition in CONDITIONS:\\\\n        table[condition] = {}\\\\n        for model in sorted({r[\\\\\\\"model\\\\\\\"] for r in records}):\\\\n            cells: dict = {}\\\\n            for split_name, split_val in [(\\\\\\\"overall\\\\\\\", None), (\\\\\\\"checksum_detectable\\\\\\\", True), (\\\\\\\"checksum_invisible\\\\\\\", False)]:\\\\n                tp = fp = fn = tn = 0\\\\n                for r in records:\\\\n                    if r[\\\\\\\"condition\\\\\\\"] != condition or r[\\\\\\\"model\\\\\\\"] != model:\\\\n                        continue\\\\n                    key = (model, r[\\\\\\\"problem_id\\\\\\\"])\\\\n                    if key in exclude_keys:\\\\n                        continue\\\\n                    if key not in baseline_correct_by_key:\\\\n                        continue\\\\n                    det = detectable_by_pid.get(r[\\\\\\\"problem_id\\\\\\\"])\\\\n                    if split_val is not None and det != split_val:\\\\n                        continue\\\\n                    gt_error = not baseline_correct_by_key[key]\\\\n                    pred_flag = bool(r[\\\\\\\"flagged_error\\\\\\\"])\\\\n                    if gt_error and pred_flag:\\\\n                        tp += 1\\\\n                    elif not gt_error and pred_flag:\\\\n                        fp += 1\\\\n                    elif gt_error and not pred_flag:\\\\n                        fn += 1\\\\n                    else:\\\\n                        tn += 1\\\\n                cells[split_name] = prf_with_ci(tp, fp, fn, tn)\\\\n            table[condition][model] = cells\\\\n    return table\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef build_correction_accuracy_table(records: list[dict], baseline_correct_by_key: dict[tuple[str, str], bool]) -> dict:\\\\n \\\\\\\"correction_accuracy_ci95\\\\\\\": [lo, hi] if p is not None else None,\\\\n                \\\\\\\"underpowered_n_lt_20\\\\\\\": n < 20,\\\\n            }\\\\n    return table\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nlogger.info(\\\\\\\"STEP 2/3: building precision/recall/F1 + correction-accuracy tables (Wilson CIs)\\\\\\\")\\\\ndetection_table_full = build_detection_table(records, They receive {b} more {unit} from a friend.\\\\\\\",\\\\n    \\\\\\\"A warehouse has {a} {unit}. \\\\\\\"Wei\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"Fatima\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"Diego\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"Priya\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"Noah\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"Aiko\\\\\\\"]\\\\nUNITS = [\\\\\\\"apples\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"boxes\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"coins\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"stickers\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"marbles\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"tickets\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"widgets\\\\\\\"]\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nclass Problem:\\\\n    def __init__(self, pid: str, text: str, [\\\\\\\"+\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"-\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"*\\\\\\\"]\\\\n        if cur >= 4:\\\\n            remaining_ops.append(\\\\\\\"//\\\\\\\")\\\\n        op = rng.choice(remaining_ops)\\\\n        if op elif op == \\\\\\\"-\\\\\\\":\\\\n            b = rng.randint(5, max(6, min(cur - 1, 200)))\\\\n            b = min(b, cur - 1) if cur > 1 else 0\\\\n            text_parts.append(f\\\\\\\"Then {name} f\\\\\\\"Then the number of {unit} is multiplied by {b} (e.g. distributed evenly {b} times over).\\\\\\\"\\\\n            )\\\\n            new_val = cur * b\\\\n        else:\\\\n            b = rng.choice([2, 3, 4, 5])\\\\n            text_parts.append(\\\\n                f\\\\\\\"Then the {unit} are split evenly into {b} groups and {name} keeps one group.\\\\\\\"\\\\n            )\\\\n            new_val = cur // b\\\\n        trace.append({\\\\\\\"a\\\\\\\": cur, \\\\\\\"op\\\\\\\": op, \\\\\\\"b\\\\\\\": b, \\\\\\\"result\\\\\\\": new_val})\\\\n        cur = new_val\\\\n    text_parts.append(f\\\\\\\"How many {unit} does {name} have now?\\\\\\\")\\\\n    return Problem(pid=pid, text=\\\\\\\" \\\\\\\".join(text_parts), trace=trace, gold_answer=cur)\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef build_problem_set(n: int, seed: int = 42) -> list[Problem]:\\\\n    rng = random.Random(seed)\\\\n    return [gen_synthetic_problem(f\\\\\\\"synth_{i:04d}\\\\\\\", rng) for i in range(n)]\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef digit_root(x) -> int:\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Closed-form casting-out-nines digit root: 1+(n-1)%9 for n>0, 0 for n=0.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    x =        x = sum(int(c) for c in str(x))\\\\n    return x\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef self_check_digit_root() -> None:\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Cross-check the closed-form digit_root against brute-force repeated\\\\n    digit-summing before trusting it at scale (STEP 4 requirement).\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    for x in [0, 1, 9, 10, 17, 45, 99, 100, 295, 401, 999, 12345, 987654]:\\\\n        a, b = digit_root(x), digit_root_brute_force(x)\\\\n        assert a == b, f\\\\\\\"digit_root mismatch at x={x}: closed-form={a} brute-force={b}\\\\\\\"\\\\n    logger.info(\\\\\\\"digit_root self-check digit_root(result)\\\\n    if op == \\\\\\\"+\\\\\\\":\\\\n        return (da + db) % 9 == dr % 9 or (da + db == 0 and dr == 0)\\\\n    if op == \\\\\\\"-\\\\\\\":\\\\n        return (da - db) % 9 == dr % 9\\\\n    if op == \\\\\\\"*\\\\\\\":\\\\n        return (da * db) % 9 == dr % 9 or (da * db == 0 and dr == 0)\\\\n    if op == \\\\\\\"//\\\\\\\":\\\\n        if b == 0:\\\\n            return False\\\\n        remainder = a - b * result\\\\n        return checksum_consistent(b, \\\\\\\"*\\\\\\\", result, a - remainder)\\\\n    raise ValueError(f\\\\\\\"unknown op {op}\\\\\\\")\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef inject_error(problem: Problem, rng: random.Random) -> dict | None:\\\\n    if not problem.trace:\\\\n        return None\\\\n    idx = rng.randrange(len(problem.trace))\\\\n    step = problem.trace[idx]\\\\n    perturb_kind = rng.choice([\\\\\\\"off_by_one_digit\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"transpose_digits\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"off_by_carry\\\\\\\"])\\\\n    wrong_result = step[\\\\\\\"result\\\\\\\"]\\\\n    if perturb_kind == \\\\\\\"off_by_one_digit\\\\\\\":\\\\n        delta = rng.choice([-1, 1]) * rng.choice([1, if wrong_result == step[\\\\\\\"result\\\\\\\"]:\\\\n        wrong_result += 1\\\\n    return {\\\\n        \\\\\\\"problem_id\\\\\\\": problem.pid,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"step_index\\\\\\\": idx,\\\\n \\\\\\\"correct_result\\\\\\\": step[\\\\\\\"result\\\\\\\"],\\\\n        \\\\\\\"wrong_result\\\\\\\": wrong_result,\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef characterize_errors(problems: list[Problem], seed: int = 7) -> dict:\\\\n    rng = random.Random(seed)\\\\n    detectable_by_pid: dict[str, bool] = {}\\\\n    for problem in problems:\\\\n        err = inject_error(problem, rng)\\\\n        if err is \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"),\\\\n                }\\\\n            )\\\\n    n_expected = sum(1 for ex in examples for k in ex if k.startswith(\\\\\\\"predict_\\\\\\\"))\\\\n    n_matched = len(records)\\\\n    n_unmatched = n_expected - n_matched\\\\n    join_report = {\\\\n        \\\\\\\"n_expected_total_llm_calls\\\\\\\": n_expected,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"n_matched_records\\\\\\\": n_matched,\\\\n intervals\\\\n\\\\nGround truth for \\\\\\\"an error was present\\\\\\\" = the same model's **baseline** (no-critique) solve on that problem was wrong. Predicted = the condition's own `flagged_error`. Each condition x model x detectability-split cell gets a closed-form Wilson 95% CI and an explicit `n<20`-underpowered flag rather than a bare point estimate. STEP 3 additionally computes, among true-positive detections, what fraction were actually corrected to the gold answer.\",\n   \"metadata\": {}\n  },\n  {\n   \"cell_type\": \"code\",\n   \"id\": \"2e978fb8\",\n   \"source\": \"def wilson_ci(k: int, n: int, z: float = 1.959963984540054) -> tuple[float | None, float | None, float | None]:\\\\n    if n == 0:\\\\n        return (None, None, None)\\\\n    p = k / n\\\\n    denom = 1 + z**2 / n\\\\n    center = (p + z**2 / (2 * n)) / denom\\\\n    halfwidth = z * math.sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z**2 / (4 * n**2)) / denom\\\\n    return (p, max(0.0, center - halfwidth), min(1.0, center + halfwidth))\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef prf_with_ci(tp: int, fp: int, fn: int, tn: int) -> dict:\\\\n    n_pred_pos = tp + fp\\\\n    n_actual_pos = tp + fn\\\\n    n_total = tp + fp + fn + tn\\\\n    precision, prec_lo, prec_hi = wilson_ci(tp, n_pred_pos) if n_pred_pos else (None, None, None)\\\\n    recall, rec_lo, rec_hi = wilson_ci(tp, n_actual_pos) if n_actual_pos else (None, None, None)\\\\n    f1 = None\\\\n    if precision is not None and recall is not None and (precision + recall) > 0:\\\\n        f1 = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)\\\\n    return {\\\\n        \\\\\\\"n\\\\\\\": n_total,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"tp\\\\\\\": tp,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"fp\\\\\\\": fp,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"fn\\\\\\\": fn,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"tn\\\\\\\": tn,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"n_predicted_positive\\\\\\\": n_pred_pos,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"n_actual_positive\\\\\\\": n_actual_pos,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"precision\\\\\\\": precision,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"precision_ci95\\\\\\\": [prec_lo, prec_hi] if precision is not None else None,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"recall\\\\\\\": recall,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"recall_ci95\\\\\\\": [rec_lo, rec_hi] if recall is not None else None,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"f1\\\\\\\": f1,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"underpowered_n_lt_20\\\\\\\": n_total < 20,\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef cohens_kappa(pairs: list[tuple[bool, bool]]) -> dict:\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"pairs: list of (rater_a_flag, rater_b_flag) booleans, paired per item.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    n = len(pairs)\\\\n    if n == 0:\\\\n        return {\\\\\\\"n\\\\\\\": 0, \\\\\\\"kappa\\\\\\\": None, \\\\\\\"po\\\\\\\": None, \\\\\\\"pe\\\\\\\": None}\\\\n    both_true = sum(1 for a, b in pairs if a and b)\\\\n    both_false = sum(1 for a, b in pairs if not a and not b)\\\\n    a_true = sum(1 for a, _ in pairs if a)\\\\n    b_true = sum(1 for _, b in pairs if b)\\\\n    po = (both_true + both_false) / n\\\\n    pe = (a_true / n) * (b_true / n) + (1 - a_true / n) * (1 - b_true / n)\\\\n    kappa = (po - pe) / (1 - pe) if pe != 1.0 else None\\\\n    return {\\\\\\\"n\\\\\\\": n, \\\\\\\"kappa\\\\\\\": kappa, \\\\\\\"po\\\\\\\": po, \\\\\\\"pe\\\\\\\": pe}\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef build_detection_table(\\\\n    records: list[dict],\\\\n    baseline_correct_by_key: dict[tuple[str, str], bool],\\\\n    detectable_by_pid: dict[str, bool],\\\\n    exclude_keys: set[tuple[str, str]] | None = None,\\\\n) -> dict:\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"condition x model x detectability-split precision/recall/F1 table.\\\\n    Ground truth = NOT baseline_correct[model,pid] (an error was actually\\\\n    present, since baseline is a single unaided solve with no chance to\\\\n    self-correct). a_true / n) * (1 - b_true / n)\\n    kappa = (po - pe) / (1 - pe) if pe != 1.0 else None\\n    return {\\\"n\\\": n, \\\"kappa\\\": kappa, \\\"po\\\": po, \\\"pe\\\": pe}\\n\\n\\ndef build_detection_table(\\n    records: list[dict],\\n    baseline_correct_by_key: dict[tuple[str, str], bool],\\n    detectable_by_pid: dict[str, bool],\\n    exclude_keys: set[tuple[str, str]] | None = None,\\n) -> dict:\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"condition x model x detectability-split precision/recall/F1 table.\\n    Ground truth = NOT baseline_correct[model,pid] (an error was actually\\n    present, since baseline is a single unaided solve with no chance to\\n    self-correct). None)\\\\n    p = k / n\\\\n    denom = 1 + z**2 / n\\\\n    center = (p + z**2 / (2 * n)) / denom\\\\n    halfwidth = z * math.sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z**2 / (4 * n**2)) / denom\\\\n    return (p, n_actual_pos else (None, None, None)\\\\n    f1 = None\\\\n    if precision is not None and recall is not None and (precision + recall) > 0:\\\\n        f1 = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)\\\\n    return {\\\\n        \\\\\\\"n\\\\\\\": n_total,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"tp\\\\\\\": tp,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"fp\\\\\\\": fp,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"fn\\\\\\\": fn,\\\\n [rec_lo, rec_hi] if recall is not None else None,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"f1\\\\\\\": f1,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"underpowered_n_lt_20\\\\\\\": n_total < 20,\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef cohens_kappa(pairs: list[tuple[bool, bool]]) -> dict:\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"pairs: list of (rater_a_flag, rater_b_flag) booleans, paired per item.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    n = len(pairs)\\\\n    if n == 0:\\\\n        return {\\\\\\\"n\\\\\\\": 0, \\\\\\\"kappa\\\\\\\": None, \\\\\\\"po\\\\\\\": None, \\\\\\\"pe\\\\\\\": None}\\\\n    both_true = sum(1 for a, b in pairs if a and b)\\\\n    both_false \\\\\\\"Wei\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"Fatima\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"Diego\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"Priya\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"Noah\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"Aiko\\\\\\\"]\\\\nUNITS = [\\\\\\\"apples\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"boxes\\\\\\\", [\\\\\\\"+\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"-\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"*\\\\\\\"]\\\\n        if cur >= 4:\\\\n            remaining_ops.append(\\\\\\\"//\\\\\\\")\\\\n        op = rng.choice(remaining_ops)\\\\n        if op gives away {b} {unit}.\\\\\\\")\\\\n            new_val = cur - b\\\\n        elif op == \\\\\\\"*\\\\\\\":\\\\n            b = rng.randint(2, 4)\\\\n            text_parts.append(\\\\n                f\\\\\\\"Then the number of {unit} is multiplied by {b} (e.g. distributed evenly {b} times over).\\\\\\\"\\\\n            )\\\\n            new_val = cur * b\\\\n        else:\\\\n            b =        new_val = cur // b\\\\n        trace.append({\\\\\\\"a\\\\\\\": cur, \\\\\\\"op\\\\\\\": op, \\\\\\\"b\\\\\\\": b, \\\\\\\"result\\\\\\\": new_val})\\\\n        cur = new_val\\\\n    text_parts.append(f\\\\\\\"How many {unit} does {name} have now?\\\\\\\")\\\\n    return Problem(pid=pid, text=\\\\\\\" \\\\\\\".join(text_parts), trace=trace, gold_answer=cur)\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef build_problem_set(n: int, seed: int = 42) -> list[Problem]:\\\\n    rng = random.Random(seed)\\\\n    return [gen_synthetic_problem(f\\\\\\\"synth_{i:04d}\\\\\\\", rng) for i in abs(int(round(x)))\\\\n    if x == 0:\\\\n        return 0\\\\n    return 1 + (x - 1) % 9\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef digit_root_brute_force(x) -> int:\\\\n    x = abs(int(round(x)))\\\\n    while x >= 10:\\\\n repeated\\\\n    digit-summing before trusting it at scale (STEP 4 requirement).\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    for x in [0, 1, 9, 10, 17, 45, 99, 100, 295, 401, 999, 12345, 987654]:\\\\n        a, b = digit_root(x), digit_root_brute_force(x)\\\\n        assert a == b, f\\\\\\\"digit_root mismatch at x={x}: closed-form={a} brute-force={b}\\\\\\\"\\\\n    logger.info(\\\\\\\"digit_root self-check PASSED (closed-form == brute-force on 13 test values)\\\\\\\")\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef checksum_consistent(a: int, op: str, b: int, result: int) -> bool:\\\\n    da, db, dr = digit_root(a), digit_root(b), digit_root(result)\\\\n    if op == \\\\\\\"+\\\\\\\":\\\\n        return (da + db) % 9 == dr % 9 or (da + db == 0 and dr == 0)\\\\n    if op == \\\\\\\"-\\\\\\\":\\\\n        return (da - db) % 9 == dr % 9\\\\n    if op == \\\\\\\"*\\\\\\\":\\\\n        return (da * db) % 9 == dr % 9 or (da * db == 0 and dr == 0)\\\\n    if op == \\\\\\\"//\\\\\\\":\\\\n        if b == 0:\\\\n            return False\\\\n        remainder = a - b * result\\\\n        return checksum_consistent(b, \\\\\\\"*\\\\\\\", result, a - remainder)\\\\n    raise ValueError(f\\\\\\\"unknown op \\\\\\\"off_by_carry\\\\\\\"])\\\\n    wrong_result = step[\\\\\\\"result\\\\\\\"]\\\\n    if perturb_kind == \\\\\\\"off_by_one_digit\\\\\\\":\\\\n        delta = rng.choice([-1, 1]) * rng.choice([1, if wrong_result == step[\\\\\\\"result\\\\\\\"]:\\\\n        wrong_result += 1\\\\n    return {\\\\n        \\\\\\\"problem_id\\\\\\\": problem.pid,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"step_index\\\\\\\": idx,\\\\n \\\\\\\"correct_result\\\\\\\": step[\\\\\\\"result\\\\\\\"],\\\\n        \\\\\\\"wrong_result\\\\\\\": wrong_result,\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef characterize_errors(problems: list[Problem], seed: int = 7) -> dict:\\\\n    rng = random.Random(seed)\\\\n    detectable_by_pid: dict[str, bool] = {}\\\\n    for problem in problems:\\\\n        err = inject_error(problem, rng)\\\\n        if err is },\n  {\n   \"cell_type\": \"markdown\",\n   \"id\": \"99167f0f\",\n   \"source\": \"## STEP 1: flatten the raw predictions + join-coverage accounting\\\\n\\\\nThe raw data stores predictions inlined per example as `predict_<condition>_<tier>` JSON strings. This flattens them into one record per (model, problem, condition) and tracks exactly how many of the expected calls were successfully matched vs dropped, with a reason for every drop -- no silent data loss.\",\n   \"metadata\": {}\n  },\n  {\n   \"cell_type\": \"code\",\n   \"id\": \"ce97c65d\",\n   \"source\": \"def records_from_examples(examples: list, model_meta: list) -> tuple[list[dict], reasons).\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    records = []\\\\n    unmatched_reasons: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)\\\\n    for i, ex in enumerate(examples):\\\\n        pid = f\\\\\\\"synth_{i:04d}\\\\\\\"\\\\n        gold = ex[\\\\\\\"metadata_gold_answer\\\\\\\"]\\\\n        for key, val in ex.items():\\\\n            if not key.startswith(\\\\\\\"predict_\\\\\\\"):\\\\n                continue\\\\n            try:\\\\n                payload = json.loads(val)\\\\n            except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):\\\\n                unmatched_reasons[\\\\\\\"predict_blob_json_parse_failure\\\\\\\"] += 1\\\\n                continue\\\\n            rest = key[len(\\\\\\\"predict_\\\\\\\") :]\\\\n            if rest.startswith(\\\\\\\"oracle_\\\\\\\"):\\\\n                condition = \\\\\\\"oracle_detection_isolation\\\\\\\"\\\\n                tier = rest[len(\\\\\\\"oracle_\\\\\\\") :]\\\\n            else:\\\\n                tier = rest.rsplit(\\\\\\\"_\\\\\\\", 1)[-1]\\\\n                condition = rest[: -(len(tier) + 1)]\\\\n            model_id = next((m[\\\\\\\"id\\\\\\\"] for m in model_meta if m[\\\\\\\"tier\\\\\\\"] == tier), tier)\\\\n            if payload.get(\\\\\\\"raw_response\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\") == \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\" and \\\\\\\"error\\\\\\\" in payload:\\\\n                unmatched_reasons[f\\\\\\\"api_error:{payload.get('error', 'unknown')[:60]}\\\\\\\"] += 1\\\\n                continue\\\\n            fa = payload.get(\\\\\\\"final_answer\\\\\\\")\\\\n            records.append(\\\\n                {\\\\n                    \\\\\\\"model\\\\\\\": model_id,\\\\n                    \\\\\\\"tier\\\\\\\": tier,\\\\n                    \\\\\\\"problem_id\\\\\\\": pid,\\\\n                    \\\\\\\"condition\\\\\\\": condition,\\\\n                    \\\\\\\"gold_answer\\\\\\\": gold,\\\\n                    \\\\\\\"final_answer\\\\\\\": fa,\\\\n                    \\\\\\\"initial_answer\\\\\\\": fa,\\\\n                    \\\\\\\"flagged_error\\\\\\\": payload.get(\\\\\\\"flagged_error\\\\\\\", False),\\\\n                    \\\\\\\"is_correct\\\\\\\": payload.get(\\\\\\\"is_correct\\\\\\\", False),\\\\n                    \\\\\\\"raw_response\\\\\\\": payload.get(\\\\\\\"raw_response\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"),\\\\n                    \\\\\\\"response_chars\\\\\\\": len(payload.get(\\\\\\\"raw_response\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\") or \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"),\\\\n                }\\\\n            )\\\\n    n_expected = sum(1 for ex in examples for k in ex if k.startswith(\\\\\\\"predict_\\\\\\\"))\\\\n    n_matched = len(records)\\\\n    n_unmatched = n_expected - n_matched\\\\n    join_report = {\\\\n        \\\\\\\"n_expected_total_llm_calls\\\\\\\": n_expected,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"n_matched_records\\\\\\\": n_matched,\\\\n        \\\\\\\"n_unmatched\\\\\\\": max(n_unmatched, 0),\\\\n        \\\\\\\"unmatched_reasons\\\\\\\": dict(unmatched_reasons),\\\\n        \\\\\\\"note\\\\\\\": (\\\\n            \\\\\\\"Matched = records with a parseable predict_* blob and a non-empty raw_response. \\\\\\\"\\\\n            \\\\\\\"Unmatched rows are NOT silently dropped -- every one is accounted for above by reason.\\\\\\\"\\\\n        ),\\\\n    }\\\\n    logger.info(f\\\\\\\"STEP1 join coverage: {n_matched} matched / {n_expected} expected ({n_unmatched} unmatched)\\\\\\\")\\\\n    return records, join_report\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nANSWER_RE = re.compile(r\\\\\\\"answer\\\\\\\\s*[:=][^\\\\\\\\d-]{0,15}(-?[\\\\\\\\d,]+(?:\\\\\\\\.\\\\\\\\d+)?)\\\\\\\", re.IGNORECASE)\\\\nFLAG_WORDS = re.compile(\\\\n    r\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\\b(error|mistake|incorrect|wrong|revis|correct(ed)?\\\\\\\\s+(answer|value)|mismatch)\\\\\\\\b\\\\\\\", re.IGNORECASE\\\\n)\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef extract_all_answers(text: str) -> list[float]:\\\\n    return [float(m.group(1).replace(\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\")) for m in ANSWER_RE.finditer(text or \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\")]\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef independent_reparse(records: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:\\\\n    n_mismatch = 0\\\\n    n_checked = 0\\\\n    for r in records:\\\\n        text = r.get(\\\\\\\"raw_response\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\")\\\\n        if not text:\\\\n            continue\\\\n        answers = extract_all_answers(text)\\\\n        final = answers[-1] if answers else None\\\\n        is_correct = final is not None and abs(final - r[\\\\\\\"gold_answer\\\\\\\"]) < 1e-6\\\\n        flagged = bool(FLAG_WORDS.search(text))\\\\n        n_checked += 1\\\\n        if r.get(\\\\\\\"final_answer\\\\\\\") is not None and final is not None and abs((r[\\\\\\\"final_answer\\\\\\\"] or 0) - final) > 1e-6:\\\\n            n_mismatch += 1\\\\n        r[\\\\\\\"final_answer\\\\\\\"] = final\\\\n        r[\\\\\\\"is_correct\\\\\\\"] = is_correct\\\\n        r[\\\\\\\"flagged_error\\\\\\\"] = flagged\\\\n    if n_checked:\\\\n        logger.info(\\\\n            f\\\\\\\"Independent re-parse of {n_checked} raw responses: {n_mismatch} final-answer \\\\\\\"\\\\n            f\\\\\\\"disagreements with the original parse ({n_mismatch / n_checked:.1%})\\\\\\\"\\\\n        )\\\\n    return records\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nexamples = data[\\\\\\\"datasets\\\\\\\"][0][\\\\\\\"examples\\\\\\\"][:N_PROBLEMS]\\\\nrecords, join_report = records_from_examples(examples, data[\\\\\\\"metadata\\\\\\\"][\\\\\\\"models\\\\\\\"])\\\\nrecords = independent_reparse(records)\\\\nbaseline_correct_by_key = {\\\\n    (r[\\\\\\\"model\\\\\\\"], r[\\\\\\\"problem_id\\\\\\\"]): r[\\\\\\\"is_correct\\\\\\\"] for r in records if r[\\\\\\\"condition\\\\\\\"] == \\\\\\\"baseline\\\\\\\"\\\\n}\\\\nlogger.info(f\\\\\\\"Baseline ground-truth-error keys available: {len(baseline_correct_by_key)}\\\\\\\")\",\n   \"metadata\": {},\n   \"execution_count\": null,\n   \"outputs\": []\n  },\n  {\n   \"cell_type\": \"markdown\",\n   \"id\": \"3365327a\",\n   \"source\": \"## STEP 2/3: precision/recall/F1 with Wilson confidence intervals\\\\n\\\\nGround truth for \\\\\\\"an error was present\\\\\\\" = the same model's **baseline** (no-critique) solve on that problem was wrong. Predicted = the condition's own `flagged_error`. Each condition x model x detectability-split cell gets a closed-form Wilson 95% CI and an explicit `n<20`-underpowered flag rather than a bare point estimate. STEP 3 additionally computes, among true-positive detections, what fraction were actually corrected to the gold answer.\",\n   \"metadata\": {}\n  },\n  {\n   \"cell_type\": \"code\",\n   \"id\": \"2e978fb8\",\n   \"source\": \"def wilson_ci(k: int, n: int, z: float = 1.959963984540054) -> tuple[float | None, float | None, float | None]:\\\\n    if n == 0:\\\\n        return (None, None, None)\\\\n    p = k / n\\\\n    denom = 1 + z**2 / n\\\\n    center = (p + z**2 / (2 * n)) / denom\\\\n    halfwidth = z * math.sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z**2 / (4 * n**2)) / denom\\\\n    return (p, max(0.0, center - halfwidth), min(1.0, center + halfwidth))\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef prf_with_ci(tp: int, fp: int, fn: int, tn: int) -> dict:\\\\n    n_pred_pos = tp + fp\\\\n    n_actual_pos = tp + fn\\\\n    n_total = tp + fp + fn + tn\\\\n    precision, prec_lo, prec_hi = wilson_ci(tp, n_pred_pos) if n_pred_pos else (None, None, None)\\\\n    recall, rec_lo, rec_hi = wilson_ci(tp, n_actual_pos) if a_true / n) * (1 - b_true / n)\n    kappa = (po - pe) / (1 - pe) if pe != 1.0 else None\n    return {\"n\": n, \"kappa\": kappa, \"po\": po, \"pe\": pe}\n\n\ndef build_detection_table(\n    records: list[dict],\n    baseline_correct_by_key: dict[tuple[str, str], bool],\n    detectable_by_pid: dict[str, bool],\n    exclude_keys: set[tuple[str, str]] | None = None,\n) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"condition x model x detectability-split precision/recall/F1 table.\n    Ground truth = NOT baseline_correct[model,pid] (an error was actually\n    present, since baseline is a single unaided solve with no chance to\n    self-correct).    \"    a0 = rng.randint(20, 500)\\n\",\n    \"    b0 = rng.randint(10, 300)\\n\",\n    \"    template = rng.choice(TEMPLATES)\\n\",\n    \"    text_parts = [template.format(name=name, unit=unit, in range(n_steps - 1):\\n\",\n    \"        remaining_ops = [\\\"+\\\", \\\"-\\\", \\\"*\\\"]\\n\",\n    \"        if cur >= 4:\\n\",\n    \"            remaining_ops.append(\\\"//\\\")\\n\",\n    \" more {unit}.\\\")\\n\",\n    \"            new_val = cur + b\\n\",\n    \"        elif op == \\\"-\\\":\\n\",\n    \"            b = rng.randint(5, max(6, min(cur - 1, 200)))\\n\",\n    \"            b = min(b, cur - 1) if cur > 1 else 0\\n\",\n    \"            text_parts.append(f\\\"Then {name} gives away {b} {unit}.\\\")\\n\",\n    \"            new_val = cur - b\\n\",\n    \"        elif op ==    \"def wilson_ci(k: int, n: int, z: float = 1.959963984540054) -> tuple[float | None, float | None, float | None]:\\n\",\n    \"    if n == 0:\\n\",\n    \"        return (None, None, None)\\n\",\n    \"    p = k / n\\n\",\n    \"    denom = 1 + z**2 / n\\n\",\n    \"    center = (p + z**2 / (2 * n)) / denom\\n\",\n    \"    halfwidth = z * math.sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z**2 / (4 * n**2)) / denom\\n\",\n    \"    return (p, max(0.0, center - halfwidth), min(1.0, center + halfwidth))\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"def prf_with_ci(tp: int, fp: int, fn: int, tn: int) -> dict:\\n\",\n    \"    n_pred_pos = tp + fp\\n\",\n    \"    n_actual_pos = tp + fn\\n\",\n    \"    n_total = tp + fp + fn + tn\\n\",\n    \"    precision, prec_lo, prec_hi = wilson_ci(tp, n_pred_pos) if n_pred_pos else (None, None, None)\\n\",\n    \"    recall, rec_lo, rec_hi = wilson_ci(tp, n_actual_pos) if n_actual_pos else (None, None, None)\\n\",\n    \"    f1 = None\\n\",\n    \"    if precision is not None and recall is not None and (precision + recall) > 0:\\n\",\n    \"        f1 = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)\\n\",\n    \"    return {\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"n\\\": n_total,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"tp\\\": tp,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"fp\\\": fp,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"fn\\\": fn,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"tn\\\": tn,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"n_predicted_positive\\\": n_pred_pos,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"n_actual_positive\\\": n_actual_pos,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"precision\\\": precision,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"precision_ci95\\\": [prec_lo, prec_hi] if precision is not None else None,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"recall\\\": recall,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"recall_ci95\\\": [rec_lo, rec_hi] if recall is not None else None,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"f1\\\": f1,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"underpowered_n_lt_20\\\": n_total < 20,\\n\",\n    \"    }\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"def cohens_kappa(pairs: list[tuple[bool, bool]]) -> dict:\\n\",\n    \"    \\\"\\\"\\\"pairs: list of (rater_a_flag, rater_b_flag) booleans, paired per item.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\",\n    \"    n = len(pairs)\\n\",\n    \"    if n == 0:\\n\",\n    \"        return {\\\"n\\\": 0, \\\"kappa\\\": None, \\\"po\\\": None, \\\"pe\\\": None}\\n\",\n    \"    both_true = sum(1 for a, b in pairs if a and b)\\n\",\n    \"    both_false = sum(1 for a, b in pairs if not a and not b)\\n\",\n    \"    a_true = sum(1 for a, _ in pairs if a)\\n\",\n    \"    b_true = sum(1 for _, b in pairs if b)\\n\",\n    \"    po = (both_true + both_false) / n\\n\",\n    \"    pe = (a_true / n) * (b_true / n) + (1 - a_true / n) * (1 - b_true / n)\\n\",\n    \"    kappa = (po - pe) / (1 - pe) if pe != 1.0 else None\\n\",\n    \"    return {\\\"n\\\": n, \\\"kappa\\\": kappa, \\\"po\\\": po, \\\"pe\\\": pe}\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"def build_detection_table(\\n\",\n    \"    records: list[dict],\\n\",\n    \"    baseline_correct_by_key: dict[tuple[str, str], bool],\\n\",\n    \"    detectable_by_pid: dict[str, bool],\\n\",\n    \"    exclude_keys: set[tuple[str, str]] | None = None,\\n\",\n    \") -> The rest-of-line char class deliberately\\n\",\n    \"# excludes letters, so it naturally stops before prose and before composite\\n\",\n    \"# \\\"Digit root of A (rootA) - Digit root of B (rootB) = ...\\\" verification lines,\\n\",\n    \"# which never have a colon immediately after the first operand and would\\n\",\n    \"# otherwise contaminate the claimed value with the check's own arithmetic.\\n\",\n    \"DIGIT_ROOT_CLAIM_RE = re.compile(r\\\"[Dd]igit root of (-?\\\\d+)\\\\s*:\\\\s*([0-9+\\\\-*/=\\\\u2192.,()\\\\s]*)\\\")\\n\",\n    \"TRAILING_INT_RE = re.compile(r\\\"-?\\\\d+\\\")\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"def check_trace_deterministic(raw_response: str) -> dict:\\n\",\n    \"    \\\"\\\"\\\"Parses every 'digit root of N: ...' claim in a trace, independently\\n\",\n    \"    recomputes the true digit root via the closed-form formula, and flags any\\n\",\n    \"    claim whose stated value disagrees with the recomputation.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\",\n    \"    claims = []\\n\",\n    \"    for m in DIGIT_ROOT_CLAIM_RE.finditer(raw_response or \\\"\\\"):\\n\",\n    \"        operand_str, rest = m.group(1), m.group(2)\\n\",\n    \"        operand = int(operand_str)\\n\",\n    \"        ints_in_rest = TRAILING_INT_RE.findall(rest)\\n\",\n    \"        if not ints_in_rest:\\n\",\n    \"            continue\\n\",\n    \"        claimed = int(ints_in_rest[-1])\\n\",\n    \"        if not (0 <= claimed <= 9):\\n\",\n    \"            continue  # not a single-digit claim -- likely mid-reduction fragment, skip\\n\",\n    \"        true_root = digit_root(operand)\\n\",\n    \"        claims.append({\\\"operand\\\": operand, \\\"claimed_root\\\": claimed, \\\"true_root\\\": true_root, \\\"match\\\": claimed == true_root})\\n\",\n    \"    n_claims = len(claims)\\n\",\n    \"    n_mismatches = sum(1 for c in claims if not c[\\\"match\\\"])\\n\",\n    \"    return {\\n\",\n    \" claims,\\n\",\n    \"    }\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"logger.info(\\\"STEP 4: deterministic mod-9 checker over ALL checksum_critique traces (no LLM calls)\\\")\\n\",\n
