\\\"tickets\\\", \\\"widgets\\\"]\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"class Problem:\\n\",\n    \"    def __init__(self, pid: str, text: str, trace: list, gold_answer: int):\\n\",\n    \"        self.pid = pid\\n\",\n    \"        self.text = text\\n\",\n    \"        self.trace = trace\\n\",\n    \"        self.gold_answer = gold_answer\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"def gen_synthetic_problem(pid: str, rng: random.Random) -> Problem:\\n\",\n    \"    n_steps = rng.randint(3, 4)\\n\",\n    \"    name = rng.choice(NAMES)\\n\",\n    \"    unit = rng.choice(UNITS)\\n\",\n    \"    a0 = rng.randint(20, 500)\\n\",\n    \"    b0 = rng.randint(10, 300)\\n\",\n    \"    template = rng.choice(TEMPLATES)\\n\",\n    \"    text_parts = [template.format(name=name, unit=unit, a=a0, b=b0)]\\n\",\n    \"    trace = []\\n\",\n    \"    cur = a0 + b0\\n\",\n    \"    trace.append({\\\"a\\\": a0, \\\"op\\\": \\\"+\\\", \\\"b\\\": b0, \\\"result\\\": cur})\\n\",\n    \"    for _ in range(n_steps - 1):\\n\",\n    \"        remaining_ops = [\\\"+\\\", \\\"-\\\", \\\"*\\\"]\\n\",\n    \"        if cur >= 4:\\n\",\n    \"            remaining_ops.append(\\\"//\\\")\\n\",\n    \"        op = rng.choice(remaining_ops)\\n\",\n    \"        if op == \\\"+\\\":\\n\",\n    \"            b = rng.randint(5, 200)\\n\",\n    \"            text_parts.append(f\\\"Then {name} receives {b} more {unit}.\\\")\\n\",\n    \"            new_val = cur + b\\n\",\n    \"        elif op == \\\"-\\\":\\n\",\n    \"            b = rng.randint(5, max(6, min(cur - 1, 200)))\\n\",\n    \"            b = min(b, cur - 1) if cur > 1 else 0\\n\",\n    \"            text_parts.append(f\\\"Then {name} gives away {b} {unit}.\\\")\\n\",\n    \"            new_val = cur - b\\n\",\n    \"        elif op == \\\"*\\\":\\n\",\n    \"            b = rng.randint(2, 4)\\n\",\n    \"            text_parts.append(\\n\",\n    \"                f\\\"Then the number of {unit} is multiplied by {b} (e.g. distributed evenly {b} times over).\\\"\\n\",\n    \"            )\\n\",\n    \"            new_val = cur * b\\n\",\n    \"        else:\\n\",\n    \"            b = rng.choice([2, 3, 4, 5])\\n\",\n    \"            text_parts.append(\\n\",\n    \"                f\\\"Then the {unit} are split evenly into {b} groups and {name} keeps one group.\\\"\\n\",\n    \"            )\\n\",\n    \"            new_val = cur // b\\n\",\n    \"        trace.append({\\\"a\\\": cur, \\\"op\\\": op, \\\"b\\\": b, \\\"result\\\": new_val})\\n\",\n    \"        cur = new_val\\n\",\n    \"    text_parts.append(f\\\"How many {unit} does {name} have now?\\\")\\n\",\n    \"    return Problem(pid=pid, text=\\\" \\\".join(text_parts), trace=trace, gold_answer=cur)\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"def build_problem_set(n: int, seed: int = 42) -> list[Problem]:\\n\",\n    \"    rng = random.Random(seed)\\n\",\n    \"    return [gen_synthetic_problem(f\\\"synth_{i:04d}\\\", rng) for i in range(n)]\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"def digit_root(x) -> int:\\n\",\n    \"    \\\"\\\"\\\"Closed-form casting-out-nines digit root: 1+(n-1)%9 for n>0, 0 for n=0.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\",\n    \"    x = abs(int(round(x)))\\n\",\n    \"    if x == 0:\\n\",\n    \"        return 0\\n\",\n    \"    return 1 + (x - 1) % 9\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"def digit_root_brute_force(x) -> int:\\n\",\n    \"    x = abs(int(round(x)))\\n\",\n    \"    while x >= 10:\\n\",\n    \"        x = sum(int(c) for c in str(x))\\n\",\n    \"    return x\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"def self_check_digit_root() -> None:\\n\",\n    \"    \\\"\\\"\\\"Cross-check the closed-form digit_root against brute-force repeated\\n\",\n    \"    digit-summing before trusting it at scale (STEP 4 requirement).\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\",\n    \"    for x in [0, 1, 9, 10, 17, 45, 99, 100, 295, 401, 999, 12345, 987654]:\\n\",\n    \"        a, b = digit_root(x), digit_root_brute_force(x)\\n\",\n    \"        assert a == b, f\\\"digit_root mismatch at x={x}: closed-form={a} brute-force={b}\\\"\\n\",\n    \"    logger.info(\\\"digit_root self-check PASSED (closed-form == brute-force on 13 test values)\\\")\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"def checksum_consistent(a: int, op: str, b: int, result: int) -> bool:\\n\",\n    \"    da, db, dr = digit_root(a), digit_root(b), digit_root(result)\\n\",\n    \"    if op == \\\"+\\\":\\n\",\n    \"        return (da + db) % 9 == dr % 9 or (da + db == 0 and dr == 0)\\n\",\n    \"    if op == \\\"-\\\":\\n\",\n    \"        return (da - db) % 9 == dr % 9\\n\",\n    \"    if op == \\\"*\\\":\\n\",\n    \"        return (da * db) % 9 == dr % 9 or (da * db == 0 and dr == 0)\\n\",\n    \"    if op == \\\"//\\\":\\n\",\n    \"        if b == 0:\\n\",\n    \"            return False\\n\",\n    \"        remainder = a - b * result\\n\",\n    \"        return checksum_consistent(b, \\\"*\\\", result, a - remainder)\\n\",\n    \"    raise ValueError(f\\\"unknown op {op}\\\")\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"def inject_error(problem: Problem, rng: random.Random) -> dict | None:\\n\",\n    \"    if not problem.trace:\\n\",\n    \"        return None\\n\",\n    \"    idx = rng.randrange(len(problem.trace))\\n\",\n    \"    step = problem.trace[idx]\\n\",\n    \"    perturb_kind = rng.choice([\\\"off_by_one_digit\\\", \\\"transpose_digits\\\", \\\"off_by_carry\\\"])\\n\",\n    \"    wrong_result = step[\\\"result\\\"]\\n\",\n    \"    if perturb_kind == \\\"off_by_one_digit\\\":\\n\",\n    \"        delta = rng.choice([-1, 1]) * rng.choice([1, 10])\\n\",\n    \"        wrong_result = step[\\\"result\\\"] + delta\\n\",\n    \"    elif perturb_kind == \\\"transpose_digits\\\":\\n\",\n    \"        s = str(abs(step[\\\"result\\\"]))\\n\",\n    \"        if len(s) >= 2:\\n\",\n    \"            i = rng.randrange(len(s) - 1)\\n\",\n    \"            s2 = s[:i] + s[i + 1] + s[i] + s[i + 2 :]\\n\",\n    \"            wrong_result = int(s2) if step[\\\"result\\\"] >= 0 else -int(s2)\\n\",\n    \"        else:\\n\",\n    \"            wrong_result = step[\\\"result\\\"] + 10\\n\",\n    \"    else:\\n\",\n    \"        wrong_result = step[\\\"result\\\"] + rng.choice([-9, 9, -18, 18])\\n\",\n    \"    if wrong_result == step[\\\"result\\\"]:\\n\",\n    \"        wrong_result += 1\\n\",\n    \"    return {\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"problem_id\\\": problem.pid,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"step_index\\\": idx,\\n\",\n    \" step[\\\"result\\\"],\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"wrong_result\\\": wrong_result,\\n\",\n    \"    }\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"def characterize_errors(problems: list[Problem], seed: int =     \\\"tier\\\": tier,\\n\",\n    \"                    \\\"problem_id\\\": pid,\\n\",\n    \"                    \\\"condition\\\": condition,\\n\",\n    \"                    \\\"gold_answer\\\": }\\n\",\n    \"            )\\n\",\n    \"    n_expected = sum(1 for ex in examples for k in ex if k.startswith(\\\"predict_\\\"))\\n\",\n    \"    n_matched = len(records)\\n\",\n    \"    n_unmatched = n_expected - n_matched\\n\",\n    \"    join_report = {\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"n_expected_total_llm_calls\\\": n_expected,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"n_matched_records\\\": unmatched)\\\")\\n\",\n    \"    return records, join_report\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"ANSWER_RE = re.compile(r\\\"answer\\\\s*[:=][^\\\\d-]{0,15}(-?[\\\\d,]+(?:\\\\.\\\\d+)?)\\\", \")\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"def extract_all_answers(text: str) -> list[float]:\\n\",\n    \"    return [float(m.group(1).replace(\\\",\\\", \\\"\\\")) for m in ANSWER_RE.finditer(text or \\\"\\\")]\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"def independent_reparse(records: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:\\n\",\n    \"    n_mismatch = 0\\n\",\n    \"    n_checked = 0\\n\",\n    \"    for r in records:\\n\",\n    \"        text = r.get(\\\"raw_response\\\", \\\"\\\")\\n\",\n    \"        if not text:\\n\",\n    \"            continue\\n\",\n    \"        answers =    \"def wilson_ci(k: int, n: int, z: float = 1.959963984540054) -> tuple[float | None, float | None, float | None]:\\n\",\n    \"    if n == 0:\\n\",\n    \"        return (None, None, None)\\n\",\n    \"    p = k / n\\n\",\n    \"    denom = 1 + z**2 / n\\n\",\n    \"    center = (p + z**2 / (2 * n)) / denom\\n\",\n    \"    halfwidth = z * math.sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z**2 / (4 * n**2)) / denom\\n\",\n    \"    return (p, max(0.0, center - halfwidth), min(1.0, center + halfwidth))\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"def prf_with_ci(tp: int, fp: int, fn: int, tn: int) -> dict:\\n\",\n    \"    n_pred_pos = tp + fp\\n\",\n    \"    n_actual_pos = tp + fn\\n\",\n    \"    n_total = tp + fp + fn + tn\\n\",\n    \"    precision, prec_lo, prec_hi = wilson_ci(tp, n_pred_pos) if n_pred_pos else (None, None, None)\\n\",\n    \"    recall, rec_lo, rec_hi = wilson_ci(tp, n_actual_pos) if n_actual_pos else (None, None, None)\\n\",\n    \"    f1 = None\\n\",\n    \"    if precision is not None and recall is not None and (precision + recall) > 0:\\n\",\n    \"        f1 = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)\\n\",\n    \"    return {\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"n\\\": n_total,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"tp\\\": tp,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"fp\\\": fp,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"fn\\\": fn,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"tn\\\": tn,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"n_predicted_positive\\\": n_pred_pos,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"n_actual_positive\\\": n_actual_pos,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"precision\\\": precision,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"precision_ci95\\\": [prec_lo, prec_hi] if precision is not None else None,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"recall\\\": recall,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"recall_ci95\\\": [rec_lo, rec_hi] if recall is not None else None,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"f1\\\": f1,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"underpowered_n_lt_20\\\": n_total < 20,\\n\",\n    \"    }\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"def cohens_kappa(pairs: list[tuple[bool, bool]]) -> dict:\\n\",\n    \"    \\\"\\\"\\\"pairs: list of (rater_a_flag, rater_b_flag) booleans, paired per item.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\",\n    \"    n = len(pairs)\\n\",\n    \"    if n == 0:\\n\",\n    \"        return {\\\"n\\\": 0, \\\"kappa\\\": None, \\\"po\\\": None, \\\"pe\\\": None}\\n\",\n    \"    both_true = sum(1 for a, b in pairs if a and b)\\n\",\n    \"    both_false = sum(1 for a, b in pairs if not a and not b)\\n\",\n    \"    a_true = sum(1 for a, _ in pairs if a)\\n\",\n    \"    b_true = sum(1 for _, b in pairs if b)\\n\",\n    \"    po = (both_true + both_false) / n\\n\",\n    \"    pe = (a_true / n) * (b_true / n) + (1 - a_true / n) * (1 - b_true / n)\\n\",\n    \"    kappa = (po - pe) / (1 - pe) if pe != 1.0 else None\\n\",\n    \"    return {\\\"n\\\": n, \\\"kappa\\\": kappa, \\\"po\\\": po, \\\"pe\\\": pe}\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"def build_detection_table(\\n\",\n    \"    records: list[dict],\\n\",\n    \"    baseline_correct_by_key: dict[tuple[str, str], bool],\\n\",\n    \"    detectable_by_pid: dict[str, bool],\\n\",\n    \"    exclude_keys: set[tuple[str, str]] | None = None,\\n\",\n    \") -> dict:\\n\",\n    \"    \\\"\\\"\\\"condition x model x detectability-split precision/recall/F1 table.\\n\",\n    \"    Ground truth = NOT baseline_correct[model,pid] (an error was actually\\n\",\n    \"    present, since baseline is a single unaided solve with no chance to\\n\",\n    \"    self-correct). Predicted = this condition's own flagged_error.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\",\n    \"    exclude_keys = exclude_keys or set()\\n\",\n    \"    table: dict = {}\\n\",\n    \"    for condition in CONDITIONS:\\n\",\n    \"        table[condition] = {}\\n\",\n    \"        for model in sorted({r[\\\"model\\\"] for r in records}):\\n\",\n    \"            cells: dict = {}\\n\",\n    \"            for split_name, split_val in [(\\\"overall\\\", None), (\\\"checksum_detectable\\\", True), (\\\"checksum_invisible\\\", False)]:\\n\",\n    \"                tp = fp = fn = tn = 0\\n\",\n    \"                for r in records:\\n\",\n    \"                    if r[\\\"condition\\\"] != condition or r[\\\"model\\\"] != model:\\n\",\n    \"                        continue\\n\",\n    \"                    key = (model, r[\\\"problem_id\\\"])\\n\",\n    \"                    if key in exclude_keys:\\n\",\n    \"                        continue\\n\",\n    \"                    if key not in baseline_correct_by_key:\\n\",\n    \"                        continue\\n\",\n    \"                    det = detectable_by_pid.get(r[\\\"problem_id\\\"])\\n\",\n    \"                    if split_val is not None and det != split_val:\\n\",\n    \"                        continue\\n\",\n    \"                    gt_error = not baseline_correct_by_key[key]\\n\",\n    \"                    pred_flag = bool(r[\\\"flagged_error\\\"])\\n\",\n    \"                    if gt_error and pred_flag:\\n\",\n    \"                        tp += 1\\n\",\n    \"                    elif not gt_error and pred_flag:\\n\",\n    \"                        fp += 1\\n\",\n    \"                    elif gt_error and not pred_flag:\\n\",\n    \"                        fn += 1\\n\",\n    \"                    else:\\n\",\n    \"                        tn += 1\\n\",\n    \"                cells[split_name] = prf_with_ci(tp, fp, fn, tn)\\n\",\n    \"            table[condition][model] = cells\\n\",\n    \"    return table\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"def build_correction_accuracy_table(records: list[dict], baseline_correct_by_key: dict[tuple[str, str], bool]) -> dict:\\n\",\n    \"    \\\"\\\"\\\"STEP3: among TP detections (flagged=True & baseline was actually wrong),\\n\",\n    \"    fraction where the condition's own final_answer == gold_answer.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\",\n    \"    table: dict = {}\\n\",\n    \"    for condition in CONDITIONS:\\n\",\n    \"        table[condition] = {}\\n\",\n    \"        for model in sorted({r[\\\"model\\\"] for r in records}):\\n\",\n    \"            tp_records = [\\n\",\n    \"                r\\n\",\n    \"                for r in records\\n\",\n    \"                if r[\\\"condition\\\"] == condition\\n\",\n    \"                and r[\\\"model\\\"] == model\\n\",\n    \"                and r[\\\"flagged_error\\\"]\\n\",\n    \"                and (model, r[\\\"problem_id\\\"]) in baseline_correct_by_key\\n\",\n    \"                and not baseline_correct_by_key[(model, r[\\\"problem_id\\\"])]\\n\",\n    \"            ]\\n\",\n    \"            n = len(tp_records)\\n\",\n    \"            k = sum(1 for r in tp_records if r[\\\"final_answer\\\"] is not None and abs(r[\\\"final_answer\\\"] - r[\\\"gold_answer\\\"]) < 1e-6)\\n\",\n    \"            p, lo, hi = wilson_ci(k, n) if n else (None, None, None)\\n\",\n    \"            table[condition][model] = {\\n\",\n    \"                \\\"n_tp\\\": n,\\n\",\n    \"                \\\"n_corrected_to_gold\\\": k,\\n\",\n    \"                \\\"correction_accuracy_given_tp\\\": p,\\n\",\n    \"                \\\"correction_accuracy_ci95\\\": [lo, hi] if p is not None else None,\\n\",\n    \"                \\\"underpowered_n_lt_20\\\": n < 20,\\n\",\n    \"            }\\n\",\n    \"    return table\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"logger.info(\\\"STEP 2/3: building precision/recall/F1 + correction-accuracy tables (Wilson CIs)\\\")\\n\",\n    \"detection_table_full = build_detection_table(records, baseline_correct_by_key, detectable_by_pid)\\n\",\n    \"correction_table = build_correction_accuracy_table(records, baseline_correct_by_key)\"\n   ]\n  },\n  {\n   \"cell_type\": \"markdown\",\n   \"id\": \"a9b79829\",\n   \"metadata\": {},\n   \"source\": [\n    \"## STEP 4: deterministic mod-9 (digit-root) arithmetic checker -- zero LLM calls\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"Every `checksum_critique` trace states claims like \\\"Digit root of 295: 2+9+5 = 16 -> 1+6 = 7\\\". This regex parses every such claim and independently recomputes the true digit root via the closed-form formula, flagging any claim that disagrees. This replaces the prior same-model LLM-judge audit (kept here for reference, but the actual fresh judge re-run over the network is skipped in this offline demo -- see note below).\"\n   ]\n  },\n  {\n   \"cell_type\": \"code\",\n   \"execution_count\": 10,\n   \"id\": \"c0639f50\",\n   \"metadata\": {\n    \"execution\": {\n     \"iopub.execute_input\": \"2026-07-31T21:22:48.292808Z\",\n     \"iopub.status.busy\": \"2026-07-31T21:22:48.292527Z\",\n     \"iopub.status.idle\": \"2026-07-31T21:22:48.298086Z\",\n     \"shell.execute_reply\": \"2026-07-31T21:22:48.297579Z\"\n    }\n   },\n   \"outputs\": [\n    {\n     \"name\": \"stdout\",\n     \"output_type\": \"stream\",\n     \"text\": [\n      \"23:22:48|INFO   |STEP 4: deterministic mod-9 checker over ALL checksum_critique traces (no LLM calls)\\n\"\n     ]\n    },\n    {\n     \"name\": \"stdout\",\n     \"output_type\": \"stream\",\n     \"text\": [\n      \"23:22:48|INFO   |Deterministic checker: 3/12 traces with >=1 checksum-arithmetic mistake (of 15 traces total, 3 had no parseable claims)\\n\"\n     ]\n    }\n   ],\n   \"source\": [\n    \"# Anchored on a colon directly after the operand (\\\"Digit root of 295: 2+9+5 = 16\\n\",\n    \"# -> 1+6 = 7\\\") -- this is how every genuine dedicated digit-root claim in the\\n\",\n    \"# inspected traces is phrased. The rest-of-line char class deliberately\\n\",\n    \"# excludes letters, so it naturally stops before prose and before composite\\n\",\n    \"# \\\"Digit root of A (rootA) - Digit root of B (rootB) = ...\\\" verification lines,\\n\",\n    \"# which never have a colon immediately after the first operand and would\\n\",\n    \"# otherwise contaminate the claimed value with the check's own arithmetic.\\n\",\n    \"DIGIT_ROOT_CLAIM_RE = re.compile(r\\\"[Dd]igit root of (-?\\\\d+)\\\\s*:\\\\s*([0-9+\\\\-*/=\\\\u2192.,()\\\\s]*)\\\")\\n\",\n    \"TRAILING_INT_RE = re.compile(r\\\"-?\\\\d+\\\")\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"def check_trace_deterministic(raw_response: str) -> dict:\\n\",\n    \"    \\\"\\\"\\\"Parses every 'digit root of N: ...' claim in a trace, independently\\n\",\n    \"    recomputes the true digit root via the closed-form formula, and flags any\\n\",\n    \"    claim whose stated value disagrees with the recomputation.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\",\n    \"    claims = []\\n\",\n    \"    for m in DIGIT_ROOT_CLAIM_RE.finditer(raw_response or \\\"\\\"):\\n\",\n    \"        operand_str, rest = m.group(1), m.group(2)\\n\",\n    \"        operand = int(operand_str)\\n\",\n    \"        ints_in_rest = TRAILING_INT_RE.findall(rest)\\n\",\n    \"        if not ints_in_rest:\\n\",\n    \"            continue\\n\",\n    \"        claimed = int(ints_in_rest[-1])\\n\",\n    \"        if not (0 <= claimed <= 9):\\n\",\n    \"            continue  # not a single-digit claim -- likely mid-reduction fragment, skip\\n\",\n    \"        true_root = digit_root(operand)\\n\",\n    \"        claims.append({\\\"operand\\\": operand, \\\"claimed_root\\\": claimed, \\\"true_root\\\": true_root, \\\"match\\\": claimed == true_root})\\n\",\n    \"    n_claims = len(claims)\\n\",\n    \"    n_mismatches = sum(1 for c in claims if not c[\\\"match\\\"])\\n\",\n    \"    return {\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"n_claims_parsed\\\": n_claims,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"n_mismatches\\\": n_mismatches,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"has_arithmetic_error\\\": n_mismatches > 0,\\n\",\n    \"        \\\"claims\\\": claims,\\n\",\n    \"    }\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"logger.info(\\\"STEP 4: deterministic mod-9 checker over ALL checksum_critique traces (no LLM calls)\\\")\\n\",\n    \"checksum_records = [r for r in records if r[\\\"condition\\\"] == \\\"checksum_critique\\\" and r[\\\"raw_response\\\"]]\\n\",\n    \"checker_by_key: dict[tuple[str, str], dict] = {}\\n\",\n    \"for r in checksum_records:\\n\",\n    \"    checker_by_key[(r[\\\"model\\\"], r[\\\"problem_id\\\"])] = check_trace_deterministic(r[\\\"raw_response\\\"])\\n\",\n    \"\\n\",\n    \"n_traces_checked = len(checker_by_key)\\n\",\n    \"n_traces_with_error = sum(1 for v in checker_by_key.values() if v[\\\"has_arithmetic_error\\\"])\\n\",\n    \"n_traces_with_any_claims = sum(1 for v in checker_by_key.values() if v[\\\"n_claims_parsed\\\"] > 0)\\n\",\n    \"checker_error_rate = n_traces_with_error / n_traces_with_any_claims if n_traces_with_any_claims else None\\n\",\n
